4. **Correctness**: Output must be a valid permutation of 0..N-1 starting with 0

Given a list of cities, find the shortest round-trip route that visits every city exactly once and returns to the start. This is one of the most famous hard problems in computer science — checking every possible route is only feasible for a handful of cities, so the AI must use clever shortcuts to find a good route quickly.

Subpasses scale from 10 cities up to 1 000, so brute-force is impossible for the larger cases. The AI's route length is compared against a simple baseline; beating it earns full marks.

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <numeric>
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>

// Wikipedia Hilbert curve implementation
void rot(int n, int *x, int *y, int rx, int ry) {
    if (ry == 0) {
        if (rx == 1) {
            *x = n - 1 - *x;
            *y = n - 1 - *y;
        }
        int t = *x;
        *x = *y;
        *y = t;
    }
}

uint64_t xy2d(int n, int x, int y) {
    int rx, ry, s;
    uint64_t d = 0;
    for (s = n / 2; s > 0; s /= 2) {
        rx = (x & s) > 0;
        ry = (y & s) > 0;
        d += (uint64_t)s * s * ((3 * rx) ^ ry);
        rot(s, &x, &y, rx, ry);
    }
    return d;
}

int main() {
    int n = 32; // grid size 32x32
    std::cout << "Testing Hilbert coordinates for 4x4 grid:" << std::endl;
    for (int y = 0; y < 4; ++y) {
        for (int x = 0; x < 4; ++x) {
            std::cout << "x=" << x << ", y=" << y << " -> d=" << xy2d(4, x, y) << std::endl;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

Approach: The provided Rust implementation provides a foundation for the graph layout challenge. It uses a force-directed (spring-embedder) approach which is effective for small to medium graphs. For the "extreme" scale (5000-10000+ nodes), the current $O(N^2)$ force calculation will be the primary bottleneck. To further scale to the 200,000 nodes mentioned in the prompt, you would need to integrate a spatial partitioning structure like a **Barnes-Hut quadtree** or **Fast Multipole Method (FMM)** to redu...

use std::io::{self, BufRead};
use std::time::{Instant};

struct Node {
    x: f64,
    y: f64,
}

fn main() -> io::Result<()> {
    let start_time = Instant::now();
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines();

    let first_line = lines.next().ok_or(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData)??;
    let parts: Vec<usize> = first_line
        .split_whitespace()
        .map(|s| s.parse().unwrap())
        .collect();
    
    if parts.len() < 2 {
        return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidData, "Invalid header"));
    }
    
    let n = parts[0];
    let m = parts[1];
    
    let mut edges = Vec::with_capacity(m);
    for _ in 0..m {
        if let Some(Ok(line)) = lines.next() {
            let endpoints: Vec<usize> = line
                .split_whitespace()
                .map(|s| s.parse().unwrap())
                .collect();
            if endpoints.len() == 2 {
                edges.push((endpoints[0], endpoints[1]));
            }
        }
    }

    // Initialize with a simple circular layout
    let mut nodes: Vec<Node> = (0..n)
        .map(|i| {
            let angle = (i as f64) * 2.0 * std::f64::consts::PI / (n as f64);
            Node {
                x: angle.cos() * 500.0,
                y: angle.sin() * 500.0,
            }
        })
        .collect();

    // Iterative Force-Directed relaxation (simplified Spring-Embedder)
    let iterations = if n > 10000 { 10 } else { 50 };
    let k = 100.0; // Ideal distance

    for _ in 0..iterations {
        if start_time.elapsed().as_secs() > 25 { break; }
        
        let mut forces = vec![(0.0, 0.0); n];

        // Repulsive forces (Note: O(N^2) complexity)
        for i in 0..n {
            for j in i+1..n {
                let dx = nodes[i].x - nodes[j].x;
                let dy = nodes[i].y - nodes[j].y;
                let dist_sq = dx * dx + dy * dy + 0.1;
                let dist = dist_sq.sqrt();
                let force = (k * k) / dist_sq;
                forces[i].0 += force * dx / dist;
                forces[i].1 += force * dy / dist;
                forces[j].0 -= force * dx / dist;
                forces[j].1 -= force * dy / dist;
            }
        }

        // Attractive forces
        for &(u, v) in &edges {
            let dx = nodes[u].x - nodes[v].x;
            let dy = nodes[u].y - nodes[v].y;
            let dist = (dx * dx + dy * dy).sqrt() + 0.1;
            let force = dist / k;
            forces[u].0 -= force * dx / dist;
            forces[u].1 -= force * dy / dist;
            forces[v].0 += force * dx / dist;
            forces[v].1 += force * dy / dist;
        }

        // Apply forces
        for i in 0..n {
            nodes[i].x += forces[i].0;
            nodes[i].y += forces[i].1;
        }
    }

    println!("{}", n);
    for node in nodes {
        println!("{:.4} {:.4}", node.x, node.y);
    }

    Ok(())
}

use std::io::{self, BufRead};

struct Solver {
    width: usize,
    height: usize,
    obstacles: Vec<Vec<bool>>,
    require_cycle: bool,
    target_count: usize,
}

impl Solver {
    fn new(width: usize, height: usize, obstacles: Vec<(usize, usize)>, require_cycle: bool) -> Self {
        let mut obs = vec![vec![false; height]; width];
        let mut target_count = width * height;
        for (x, y) in obstacles {
            if x < width && y < height {
                if !obs[x][y] {
                    obs[x][y] = true;
                    target_count -= 1;
                }
            }
        }
        Solver { width, height, obstacles: obs, require_cycle, target_count }
    }

    fn solve(&self) -> Option<Vec<(usize, usize)>> {
        let mut path = Vec::with_capacity(self.target_count);
        let mut visited = vec![vec![false; self.height]; self.width];
        
        if self.obstacles[0][0] { return None; }
        
        path.push((0, 0));
        visited[0][0] = true;
        
        if self.backtrack(&mut path, &mut visited) {
            Some(path)
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    fn backtrack(&self, path: &mut Vec<(usize, usize)>, visited: &mut Vec<Vec<bool>>) -> bool {
        if path.len() == self.target_count {
            if self.require_cycle {
                let (lx, ly) = *path.last().unwrap();
                // Check if last is adjacent to (0,0)
                let dist = (lx as isize - 0).abs() + (ly as isize - 0).abs();
                return dist == 1;
            }
            return true;
        }

        let (cx, cy) = *path.last().unwrap();
        let neighbors = [
            (cx as isize + 1, cy as isize),
            (cx as isize - 1, cy as isize),
            (cx as isize, cy as isize + 1),
            (cx as isize, cy as isize - 1),
        ];

        for (nx, ny) in neighbors {
            if nx >= 0 && nx < self.width as isize && ny >= 0 && ny < self.height as isize {
                let (nx, ny) = (nx as usize, ny as usize);
                if !self.obstacles[nx][ny] && !visited[nx][ny] {
                    visited[nx][ny] = true;
                    path.push((nx, ny));
                    if self.backtrack(path, visited) { return true; }
                    path.pop();
                    visited[nx][ny] = false;
                }
            }
        }
        false
    }
}

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut lines = stdin.lock().lines();
    
    let first_line = lines.next().unwrap().unwrap();
    let params: Vec<usize> = first_line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
    let width = params[0];
    let height = params[1];
    let obs_count = params[2];
    let require_cycle = params[3] == 1;
    
    let mut obstacles = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..obs_count {
        let line = lines.next().unwrap().unwrap();
        let coords: Vec<usize> = line.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.parse().unwrap()).collect();
        obstacles.push((coords[0], coords[1]));
    }
    
    let solver = Solver::new(width, height, obstacles, require_cycle);
    match solver.solve() {
        Some(path) => {
            println!("{}", path.len());
            for (x, y) in path {
                println!("{} {}", x, y);
            }
        }
        None => println!("0"),
    }
}

using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;

class Program
{
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        using (var reader = new StreamReader(Console.OpenStandardInput(8192)))
        {
            string firstLine = reader.ReadLine();
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(firstLine)) return;

            string[] parts = firstLine.Trim().Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
            int N = int.Parse(parts[0]);
            double mu = double.Parse(parts[1]);

            string secondLine = reader.ReadLine();
            double[] startOrbit = ParseOrbit(secondLine);

            double[][] stationOrbits = new double[N][];
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            {
                stationOrbits[i] = ParseOrbit(reader.ReadLine());
            }

            int[] visitOrder = SolveOTSP(N, mu, startOrbit, stationOrbits);

            Console.WriteLine(string.Join(" ", visitOrder));
        }
    }

    static double[] ParseOrbit(string line)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(line)) return new double[6];
        string[] parts = line.Trim().Split(new[] { ' ', '\t' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        double[] orbit = new double[6];
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        {
            orbit[i] = double.Parse(parts[i]);
        }
        return orbit;
    }

    static int[] SolveOTSP(int N, double mu, double[] startOrbit, double[][] stationOrbits)
    {
        double[] distStart = new double[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            distStart[i] = EstimateTransferDeltaV(startOrbit, stationOrbits[i], mu);
            if (double.IsNaN(distStart[i])) Console.Error.WriteLine($"distStart[{i}] is NaN");
        }

        double[][] dist = new double[N][];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
        {
            dist[i] = new double[N];
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
            {
                if (i == j) dist[i][j] = 0;
                else
                {
                    dist[i][j] = EstimateTransferDeltaV(stationOrbits[i], stationOrbits[j], mu);
                    if (double.IsNaN(dist[i][j])) Console.Error.WriteLine($"dist[{i}][{j}] is NaN");
                }
            }
        }

        if (N <= 20)
        {
            return SolveDP(N, distStart, dist);
        }
        else
        {
            return SolveSA(N, distStart, dist);
        }
    }

    static int[] SolveDP(int N, double[] distStart, double[][] dist)
    {
        int numStates = (1 << N);
        double[] dp = new double[numStates * N];
        for (int i = 0; i < dp.Length; i++) dp[i] = double.MaxValue;

        for (int v = 0; v < N; v++)
        {
            dp[(1 << v) * N + v] = distStart[v];
        }

        for (int mask = 1; mask < numStates; mask++)
        {
            for (int v = 0; v < N; v++)
            {
                if ((mask & (1 << v)) == 0) continue;
                double currentVal = dp[mask * N + v];
                if (currentVal == double.MaxValue) continue;

                for (int u = 0; u < N; u++)
                {
                    if ((mask & (1 << u)) != 0) continue;
                    int nextMask = mask | (1 << u);
                    double nextCost = currentVal + dist[v][u];
                    int nextState = nextMask * N + u;
                    if (nextCost < dp[nextState])
                    {
                        dp[nextState] = nextCost;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int bestLast = -1;
        double minCost = double.MaxValue;
        int finalMask = numStates - 1;
        for (int v = 0; v < N; v++)
        {
            double cost = dp[finalMask * N + v];
            if (cost < minCost)
            {
                minCost = cost;
                bestLast = v;
            }
        }

        int[] path = new int[N];
        int currentMask = finalMask;
        int currentLast = bestLast;
        path[N - 1] = currentLast;

        for (int step = N - 2; step >= 0; step--)
        {
            int prevMask = currentMask ^ (1 << currentLast);
            int prevLast = -1;
            double targetCost = dp[currentMask * N + currentLast];

            for (int u = 0; u < N; u++)
            {
                if ((prevMask & (1 << u)) == 0) continue;
                double diff = Math.Abs(dp[prevMask * N + u] + dist[u][currentLast] - targetCost);
                if (diff < 1e-9)
                {
                    prevLast = u;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (prevLast == -1)
            {
                double bestDiff = double.MaxValue;
                for (int u = 0; u < N; u++)
                {
                    if ((prevMask & (1 << u)) == 0) continue;
                    double diff = Math.Abs(dp[prevMask * N + u] + dist[u][currentLast] - targetCost);
                    if (diff < bestDiff)
                    {
                        bestDiff = diff;
                        prevLast = u;
                    }
                }
            }

            path[step] = prevLast;
            currentMask = prevMask;
            currentLast = prevLast;
        }

        return path;
    }

    static int[] SolveSA(int N, double[] distStart, double[][] dist)
    {
        Random rng = new Random(42);

        // Nearest Neighbor Greedy Initialization
        int[] bestGlobalTour = new int[N];
        bool[] visited = new bool[N];
        int current = -1;
        for (int step = 0; step < N; step++)
        {
            int nextNode = -1;
            double bestDist = double.MaxValue;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            {
                if (!visited[i])
                {
                    double d = (current == -1) ? distStart[i] : dist[current][i];
                    if (d < bestDist)
                    {
                        bestDist = d;
                        nextNode = i;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (nextNode == -1)
            {
                Console.Error.WriteLine($"Greedy failed: nextNode is -1 at step {step}, current is {current}");
                // Find first unvisited as fallback
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
                {
                    if (!visited[i])
                    {
                        nextNode = i;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            bestGlobalTour[step] = nextNode;
            visited[nextNode] = true;
            current = nextNode;
        }

        Console.Error.WriteLine("Greedy tour: " + string.Join(" ", bestGlobalTour));

        double bestGlobalCost = EvaluateTour(bestGlobalTour, distStart, dist);
        bestGlobalCost = Refine2Opt(bestGlobalTour, distStart, dist, bestGlobalCost);

        var stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        long timeLimitMs = N > 50 ? 2500 : 1500;

        int restartCount = 0;
        int[] currentTour = new int[N];
        int[] bestRestartTour = new int[N];

        while (stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds < timeLimitMs)
        {
            if (restartCount == 0)
            {
                Array.Copy(bestGlobalTour, currentTour, N);
            }
            else
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) currentTour[i] = i;
                for (int i = N - 1; i > 0; i--)
                {
                    int j = rng.Next(0, i + 1);
                    int tempVal = currentTour[i];
                    currentTour[i] = currentTour[j];
                    currentTour[j] = tempVal;
                }
            }

            double currentCost = EvaluateTour(currentTour, distStart, dist);
            Array.Copy(currentTour, bestRestartTour, N);
            double bestRestartCost = currentCost;

            double initialTemp = 100.0;
            double finalTemp = 0.001;
            int iterations = 100000;
            double coolingRate = Math.Pow(finalTemp / initialTemp, 1.0 / iterations);
            double temp = initialTemp;

            for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; iter++)
            {
                int i = rng.Next(0, N);
                int j = rng.Next(0, N);
                if (i == j) continue;
                if (i > j) { int tmp = i; i = j; j = tmp; }

                double delta = 0;
                if (i > 0 && j < N - 1)
                {
                    delta = - dist[currentTour[i - 1]][currentTour[i]]
                            - dist[currentTour[j]][currentTour[j + 1]]
                            + dist[currentTour[i - 1]][currentTour[j]]
                            + dist[currentTour[i]][currentTour[j + 1]];
                }
                else if (i == 0 && j < N - 1)
                {
                    delta = - distStart[currentTour[0]]
                            - dist[currentTour[j]][currentTour[j + 1]]
                            + distStart[currentTour[j]]
                            + dist[currentTour[0]][currentTour[j + 1]];
                }
                else if (i > 0 && j == N - 1)
                {
                    delta = - dist[currentTour[i - 1]][currentTour[i]]
                            + dist[currentTour[i - 1]][currentTour[j]];
                }
                else if (i == 0 && j == N - 1)
                {
                    delta = - distStart[currentTour[0]]
                            + distStart[currentTour[j]];
                }

                if (delta < 0 || rng.NextDouble() < Math.Exp(-delta / temp))
                {
                    Array.Reverse(currentTour, i, j - i + 1);
                    currentCost += delta;

                    if (currentCost < bestRestartCost)
                    {
                        bestRestartCost = currentCost;
                        Array.Copy(currentTour, bestRestartTour, N);
                    }
                }

                temp *= coolingRate;
            }

            bestRestartCost = Refine2Opt(bestRestartTour, distStart, dist, bestRestartCost);

            if (bestRestartCost < bestGlobalCost)
            {
                bestGlobalCost = bestRestartCost;
                Array.Copy(bestRestartTour, bestGlobalTour, N);
            }

            restartCount++;
        }

        return bestGlobalTour;
    }

    static double Refine2Opt(int[] tour, double[] distStart, double[][] dist, double currentCost)
    {
        int N = tour.Length;
        bool improved = true;
        while (improved)
        {
            improved = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            {
                for (int j = i + 1; j < N; j++)
                {
                    double delta = 0;
                    if (i > 0 && j < N - 1)
                    {
                        delta = - dist[tour[i - 1]][tour[i]]
                                - dist[tour[j]][tour[j + 1]]
                                + dist[tour[i - 1]][tour[j]]
                                + dist[tour[i]][tour[j + 1]];
                    }
                    else if (i == 0 && j < N - 1)
                    {
                        delta = - distStart[tour[0]]
                                - dist[tour[j]][tour[j + 1]]
                                + distStart[tour[j]]
                                + dist[tour[0]][tour[j + 1]];
                    }
                    else if (i > 0 && j == N - 1)
                    {
                        delta = - dist[tour[i - 1]][tour[i]]
                                + dist[tour[i - 1]][tour[j]];
                    }
                    else if (i == 0 && j == N - 1)
                    {
                        delta = - distStart[tour[0]]
                                + distStart[tour[j]];
                    }

                    if (delta < -1e-9)
                    {
                        Array.Reverse(tour, i, j - i + 1);
                        currentCost += delta;
                        improved = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return currentCost;
    }

    static double EvaluateTour(int[] tour, double[] distStart, double[][] dist)
    {
        double cost = distStart[tour[0]];
        for (int i = 0; i < tour.Length - 1; i++)
        {
            cost += dist[tour[i]][tour[i + 1]];
        }
        return cost;
    }

    static double EstimateTransferDeltaV(double[] orbit1, double[] orbit2, double mu)
    {
        double r1_x = orbit1[0];
        double r1_y = orbit1[1];
        double r1_z = orbit1[2];
        double v1_x = orbit1[3];
        double v1_y = orbit1[4];
        double v1_z = orbit1[5];

        double r2_x = orbit2[0];
        double r2_y = orbit2[1];
        double r2_z = orbit2[2];
        double v2_x = orbit2[3];
        double v2_y = orbit2[4];
        double v2_z = orbit2[5];

        double r1 = Math.Sqrt(r1_x * r1_x + r1_y * r1_y + r1_z * r1_z);
        double r2 = Math.Sqrt(r2_x * r2_x + r2_y * r2_y + r2_z * r2_z);
        double v1 = Math.Sqrt(v1_x * v1_x + v1_y * v1_y + v1_z * v1_z);
        double v2 = Math.Sqrt(v2_x * v2_x + v2_y * v2_y + v2_z * v2_z);

        double h1_x = r1_y * v1_z - r1_z * v1_y;
        double h1_y = r1_z * v1_x - r1_x * v1_z;
        double h1_z = r1_x * v1_y - r1_y * v1_x;

        double h2_x = r2_y * v2_z - r2_z * v2_y;
        double h2_y = r2_z * v2_x - r2_x * v2_z;
        double h2_z = r2_x * v2_y - r2_y * v2_x;

        double h1_mag = Math.Sqrt(h1_x * h1_x + h1_y * h1_y + h1_z * h1_z);
        double h2_mag = Math.Sqrt(h2_x * h2_x + h2_y * h2_y + h2_z * h2_z);

        double plane_change_angle = 0;
        if (h1_mag > 0 && h2_mag > 0)
        {
            double h1_nx = h1_x / h1_mag;
            double h1_ny = h1_y / h1_mag;
            double h1_nz = h1_z / h1_mag;

            double h2_nx = h2_x / h2_mag;
            double h2_ny = h2_y / h2_mag;
            double h2_nz = h2_z / h2_mag;

            double cos_plane_change = h1_nx * h2_nx + h1_ny * h2_ny + h1_nz * h2_nz;
            cos_plane_change = Math.Max(-1.0, Math.Min(1.0, cos_plane_change));
            plane_change_angle = Math.Acos(cos_plane_change);
        }

        double a_transfer = (r1 + r2) / 2.0;
        double in_plane_dv = 0;
        if (a_transfer > 0)
        {
            double v_t1 = Math.Sqrt(mu * (2.0 / r1 - 1.0 / a_transfer));
            double v_t2 = Math.Sqrt(mu * (2.0 / r2 - 1.0 / a_transfer));
            double v_c1 = Math.Sqrt(mu / r1);
            double v_c2 = Math.Sqrt(mu / r2);

            double dv1 = Math.Abs(v_t1 - v_c1);
            double dv2 = Math.Abs(v_c2 - v_t2);
            in_plane_dv = dv1 + dv2;
        }
        else
        {
            in_plane_dv = Math.Abs(v2 - v1);
        }

        double v_at_node = Math.Sqrt(mu * (2.0 / r1 + 2.0 / r2) / 2.0);
        double plane_change_dv = 2.0 * v_at_node * Math.Sin(plane_change_angle / 2.0);

        double total_dv = in_plane_dv + plane_change_dv;

        double vel_magnitude_diff = Math.Abs(v2 - v1);
        double velocity_penalty = vel_magnitude_diff * 0.1;

        return total_dv + velocity_penalty;
    }
}

// Custom fast parser using fread
class FastInput {
    static const int BUF_SIZE = 1 << 20;
    std::vector<char> buf;
    int buf_pos = 0;
    int buf_len = 0;

    char get_char() {
        if (buf.empty()) buf.resize(BUF_SIZE);
        if (buf_pos >= buf_len) {
            buf_len = fread(buf.data(), 1, BUF_SIZE, stdin);
            buf_pos = 0;
            if (buf_len == 0) return EOF;
        }
        return buf[buf_pos++];
    }

public:
    int read_int() {
        int x = 0;
        char c = get_char();
        while (c <= 32 && c != EOF) c = get_char();
        if (c == EOF) return 0;
        bool neg = false;
        if (c == '-') {
            neg = true;
            c = get_char();
        }
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            x = x * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = get_char();
        }
        return neg ? -x : x;
    }

    double read_double() {
        char c = get_char();
        while (c <= 32 && c != EOF) c = get_char();
        if (c == EOF) return 0.0;
        bool neg = false;
        if (c == '-') {
            neg = true;
            c = get_char();
        }
        double x = 0.0;
        while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            x = x * 10.0 + (c - '0');
            c = get_char();
        }
        if (c == '.') {
            c = get_char();
            double dec = 0.1;
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                x += (c - '0') * dec;
                dec *= 0.1;
                c = get_char();
            }
        }
        if (c == 'e' || c == 'E') {
            c = get_char();
            bool exp_neg = false;
            if (c == '-') {
                exp_neg = true;
                c = get_char();
            } else if (c == '+') {
                c = get_char();
            }
            int exp = 0;
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                exp = exp * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = get_char();
            }
            if (exp_neg) {
                x /= std::pow(10.0, exp);
            } else {
                x *= std::pow(10.0, exp);
            }
        }
        return neg ? -x : x;
    }
};

class FastOutput {
    static const int BUF_SIZE = 1 << 20;
    std::vector<char> buf;
    int buf_pos = 0;

    void flush() {
        if (buf_pos > 0) {
            fwrite(buf.data(), 1, buf_pos, stdout);
            buf_pos = 0;
        }
    }

    void put_char(char c) {
        if (buf.empty()) buf.resize(BUF_SIZE);
        if (buf_pos >= BUF_SIZE) flush();
        buf[buf_pos++] = c;
    }

public:
    ~FastOutput() {
        flush();
    }

    void write_int(long long x) {
        if (x < 0) {
            put_char('-');
            x = -x;
        }
        char temp[30];
        int idx = 0;
        do {
            temp[idx++] = (x % 10) + '0';
            x /= 10;
        } while (x > 0);
        while (idx > 0) {
            put_char(temp[--idx]);
        }
    }

    void write_double(double x) {
        if (std::isnan(x)) {
            write_string("nan");
            return;
        }
        if (std::isinf(x)) {
            if (x < 0) put_char('-');
            write_string("inf");
            return;
        }
        if (x < 0.0) {
            put_char('-');
            x = -x;
        }
        double integer_part;
        double fractional_part = std::modf(x, &integer_part);
        
        unsigned long long int_val = (unsigned long long)integer_part;
        write_int((long long)int_val);
        
        put_char('.');
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
            fractional_part *= 10.0;
            int digit = (int)std::floor(fractional_part);
            put_char(digit + '0');
            fractional_part -= digit;
        }
    }

    void write_string(const char* s) {
        while (*s) {
            put_char(*s++);
        }
    }
    
    void write_newline() {
        put_char('\n');
    }
    
    void write_space() {
        put_char(' ');
    }
};

struct Point3D {
    double x, y, z;
    Point3D operator+(const Point3D& o) const { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }
    Point3D operator-(const Point3D& o) const { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }
    Point3D operator*(double s) const { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }
    double dot(const Point3D& o) const { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }
    Point3D cross(const Point3D& o) const {
        return {
            y * o.z - z * o.y,
            z * o.x - x * o.z,
            x * o.y - y * o.x
        };
    }
    double normSq() const { return x * x + y * y + z * z; }
    double norm() const { return std::sqrt(normSq()); }
};

struct Face {
    int v[3];
};

struct Mesh {
    std::vector<Point3D> vertices;
    std::vector<Face> faces;
};

struct AABB {
    double min_x, min_y, min_z;
    double max_x, max_y, max_z;
    bool intersects(const AABB& other) const {
        return min_x <= other.max_x && max_x >= other.min_x &&
               min_y <= other.max_y && max_y >= other.min_y &&
               min_z <= other.max_z && max_z >= other.min_z;
    }
    bool contains(const Point3D& p) const {
        return p.x >= min_x && p.x <= max_x &&
               p.y >= min_y && p.y <= max_y &&
               p.z >= min_z && p.z <= max_z;
    }
};

struct BVHNode {
    AABB box;
    int left_child = -1;
    int right_child = -1;
    std::vector<int> face_indices;
    bool is_leaf() const { return left_child == -1 && right_child == -1; }
};

class BVH {
public:
    std::vector<BVHNode> nodes;
    int root = -1;
    
    void build(const Mesh& mesh) {
        std::vector<int> indices(mesh.faces.size());
        std::iota(indices.begin(), indices.end(), 0);
        nodes.clear();
        if (indices.empty()) return;
        root = build_recursive(mesh, indices, 0, indices.size());
    }
    
    template<typename Callback>
    void intersect_ray(const Point3D& p, const Point3D& dir, Callback callback) const {
        if (root == -1) return;
        intersect_ray_recursive(root, p, dir, callback);
    }
    
    template<typename Callback>
    void intersect_box(const AABB& box, Callback callback) const {
        if (root == -1) return;
        intersect_box_recursive(root, box, callback);
    }

private:
    int build_recursive(const Mesh& mesh, std::vector<int>& indices, int start, int end) {
        int node_idx = nodes.size();
        nodes.emplace_back();
        
        AABB box = compute_aabb(mesh, indices, start, end);
        nodes[node_idx].box = box;
        
        int count = end - start;
        if (count <= 4) {
            nodes[node_idx].face_indices.assign(indices.begin() + start, indices.begin() + end);
            return node_idx;
        }
        
        double dx = box.max_x - box.min_x;
        double dy = box.max_y - box.min_y;
        double dz = box.max_z - box.min_z;
        int axis = 0;
        if (dy > dx && dy > dz) axis = 1;
        else if (dz > dx && dz > dy) axis = 2;
        
        auto get_centroid = [&](int idx) {
            const auto& F = mesh.faces[idx];
            return (mesh.vertices[F.v[0]] + mesh.vertices[F.v[1]] + mesh.vertices[F.v[2]]) * (1.0 / 3.0);
        };
        
        std::sort(indices.begin() + start, indices.begin() + end, [&](int a, int b) {
            Point3D ca = get_centroid(a);
            Point3D cb = get_centroid(b);
            if (axis == 0) return ca.x < cb.x;
            if (axis == 1) return ca.y < cb.y;
            return ca.z < cb.z;
        });
        
        int mid = start + count / 2;
        int left = build_recursive(mesh, indices, start, mid);
        int right = build_recursive(mesh, indices, mid, end);
        
        nodes[node_idx].left_child = left;
        nodes[node_idx].right_child = right;
        return node_idx;
    }
    
    AABB compute_aabb(const Mesh& mesh, const std::vector<int>& indices, int start, int end) {
        AABB box = {
            std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(), std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(), std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(),
            -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(), -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(), -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity()
        };
        for (int i = start; i < end; ++i) {
            const auto& F = mesh.faces[indices[i]];
            for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
                const auto& v = mesh.vertices[F.v[j]];
                box.min_x = std::min(box.min_x, v.x);
                box.min_y = std::min(box.min_y, v.y);
                box.min_z = std::min(box.min_z, v.z);
                box.max_x = std::max(box.max_x, v.x);
                box.max_y = std::max(box.max_y, v.y);
                box.max_z = std::max(box.max_z, v.z);
            }
        }
        return box;
    }
    
    bool ray_intersects_aabb(const Point3D& p, const Point3D& dir, const AABB& box) const {
        double tmin = 0.0, tmax = std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity();
        
        if (std::abs(dir.x) < 1e-15) {
            if (p.x < box.min_x || p.x > box.max_x) return false;
        } else {
            double t1 = (box.min_x - p.x) / dir.x;
            double t2 = (box.max_x - p.x) / dir.x;
            if (t1 > t2) std::swap(t1, t2);
            tmin = std::max(tmin, t1);
            tmax = std::min(tmax, t2);
            if (tmin > tmax) return false;
        }
        
        if (std::abs(dir.y) < 1e-15) {
            if (p.y < box.min_y || p.y > box.max_y) return false;
        } else {
            double t1 = (box.min_y - p.y) / dir.y;
            double t2 = (box.max_y - p.y) / dir.y;
            if (t1 > t2) std::swap(t1, t2);
            tmin = std::max(tmin, t1);
            tmax = std::min(tmax, t2);
            if (tmin > tmax) return false;
        }
        
        if (std::abs(dir.z) < 1e-15) {
            if (p.z < box.min_z || p.z > box.max_z) return false;
        } else {
            double t1 = (box.min_z - p.z) / dir.z;
            double t2 = (box.max_z - p.z) / dir.z;
            if (t1 > t2) std::swap(t1, t2);
            tmin = std::max(tmin, t1);
            tmax = std::min(tmax, t2);
            if (tmin > tmax) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    
    template<typename Callback>
    void intersect_ray_recursive(int node_idx, const Point3D& p, const Point3D& dir, Callback callback) const {
        const auto& node = nodes[node_idx];
        if (!ray_intersects_aabb(p, dir, node.box)) return;
        
        if (node.is_leaf()) {
            for (int idx : node.face_indices) {
                callback(idx);
            }
        } else {
            intersect_ray_recursive(node.left_child, p, dir, callback);
            intersect_ray_recursive(node.right_child, p, dir, callback);
        }
    }
    
    template<typename Callback>
    void intersect_box_recursive(int node_idx, const AABB& box, Callback callback) const {
        const auto& node = nodes[node_idx];
        if (!node.box.intersects(box)) return;
        
        if (node.is_leaf()) {
            for (int idx : node.face_indices) {
                callback(idx);
            }
        } else {
            intersect_box_recursive(node.left_child, box, callback);
            intersect_box_recursive(node.right_child, box, callback);
        }
    }
};

void intersect_bvhs(const Mesh& meshA, const BVH& bvhA, int nodeA,
                    const Mesh& meshB, const BVH& bvhB, int nodeB,
                    std::vector<std::pair<int, int>>& intersecting_pairs) {
    const auto& nA = bvhA.nodes[nodeA];
    const auto& nB = bvhB.nodes[nodeB];
    if (!nA.box.intersects(nB.box)) return;
    
    if (nA.is_leaf() && nB.is_leaf()) {
        for (int idxA : nA.face_indices) {
            for (int idxB : nB.face_indices) {
                intersecting_pairs.push_back({idxA, idxB});
            }
        }
    } else if (nA.is_leaf()) {
        intersect_bvhs(meshA, bvhA, nodeA, meshB, bvhB, nB.left_child, intersecting_pairs);
        intersect_bvhs(meshA, bvhA, nodeA, meshB, bvhB, nB.right_child, intersecting_pairs);
    } else if (nB.is_leaf()) {
        intersect_bvhs(meshA, bvhA, nA.left_child, meshB, bvhB, nodeB, intersecting_pairs);
        intersect_bvhs(meshA, bvhA, nA.right_child, meshB, bvhB, nodeB, intersecting_pairs);
    } else {
        double volA = (nA.box.max_x - nA.box.min_x) * (nA.box.max_y - nA.box.min_y) * (nA.box.max_z - nA.box.min_z);
        double volB = (nB.box.max_x - nB.box.min_x) * (nB.box.max_y - nB.box.min_y) * (nB.box.max_z - nB.box.min_z);
        if (volA > volB) {
            intersect_bvhs(meshA, bvhA, nA.left_child, meshB, bvhB, nodeB, intersecting_pairs);
            intersect_bvhs(meshA, bvhA, nA.right_child, meshB, bvhB, nodeB, intersecting_pairs);
        } else {
            intersect_bvhs(meshA, bvhA, nodeA, meshB, bvhB, nB.left_child, intersecting_pairs);
            intersect_bvhs(meshA, bvhA, nodeA, meshB, bvhB, nB.right_child, intersecting_pairs);
        }
    }
}

struct Triangle3D {
    Point3D p[3];
};

double distSq(const Point3D& a, const Point3D& b) {
    double dx = a.x - b.x;
    double dy = a.y - b.y;
    double dz = a.z - b.z;
    return dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
}

std::vector<Point3D> get_plane_intersection_points(const Triangle3D& T, const Point3D& N2, double d2) {
    double d[3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        d[i] = T.p[i].dot(N2) + d2;
    }
    std::vector<Point3D> pts;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        int next = (i + 1) % 3;
        if (std::abs(d[i]) < 1e-9) {
            pts.push_back(T.p[i]);
        } else if ((d[i] > 0 && d[next] < 0) || (d[i] < 0 && d[next] > 0)) {
            double s = -d[i] / (d[next] - d[i]);
            s = std::max(0.0, std::min(1.0, s));
            pts.push_back(T.p[i] + (T.p[next] - T.p[i]) * s);
        }
    }
    std::vector<Point3D> unique_pts;
    for (const auto& p : pts) {
        bool duplicate = false;
        for (const auto& up : unique_pts) {
            if ((p - up).normSq() < 1e-18) {
                duplicate = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!duplicate) {
            unique_pts.push_back(p);
        }
    }
    return unique_pts;
}

bool intersect_triangles(const Triangle3D& T1, const Triangle3D& T2, Point3D& pStart, Point3D& pEnd) {
    Point3D N1 = (T1.p[1] - T1.p[0]).cross(T1.p[2] - T1.p[0]);
    double len1 = N1.norm();
    if (len1 < 1e-12) return false;
    N1 = N1 * (1.0 / len1);
    double d1 = -N1.dot(T1.p[0]);
    
    double d2_vals[3];
    bool has_pos2 = false, has_neg2 = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        d2_vals[i] = N1.dot(T2.p[i]) + d1;
        if (d2_vals[i] > 1e-9) has_pos2 = true;
        else if (d2_vals[i] < -1e-9) has_neg2 = true;
    }
    if (!has_pos2 || !has_neg2) return false;
    
    Point3D N2 = (T2.p[1] - T2.p[0]).cross(T2.p[2] - T2.p[0]);
    double len2 = N2.norm();
    if (len2 < 1e-12) return false;
    N2 = N2 * (1.0 / len2);
    double d2 = -N2.dot(T2.p[0]);
    
    double d1_vals[3];
    bool has_pos1 = false, has_neg1 = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        d1_vals[i] = N2.dot(T1.p[i]) + d2;
        if (d1_vals[i] > 1e-9) has_pos1 = true;
        else if (d1_vals[i] < -1e-9) has_neg1 = true;
    }
    if (!has_pos1 || !has_neg1) return false;
    
    std::vector<Point3D> A_pts = get_plane_intersection_points(T1, N2, d2);
    std::vector<Point3D> B_pts = get_plane_intersection_points(T2, N1, d1);
    if (A_pts.size() != 2 || B_pts.size() != 2) return false;
    
    Point3D D = N1.cross(N2);
    double tA1 = A_pts[0].dot(D);
    double tA2 = A_pts[1].dot(D);
    Point3D A1 = A_pts[0], A2 = A_pts[1];
    if (tA1 > tA2) { std::swap(tA1, tA2); std::swap(A1, A2); }
    
    double tB1 = B_pts[0].dot(D);
    double tB2 = B_pts[1].dot(D);
    Point3D B1 = B_pts[0], B2 = B_pts[1];
    if (tB1 > tB2) { std::swap(tB1, tB2); std::swap(B1, B2); }
    
    double tStart = std::max(tA1, tB1);
    double tEnd = std::min(tA2, tB2);
    
    if (tStart < tEnd - 1e-9) {
        pStart = (tA1 > tB1) ? A1 : B1;
        pEnd = (tA2 < tB2) ? A2 : B2;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

struct Point2D {
    double x, y;
    Point2D operator+(const Point2D& o) const { return {x + o.x, y + o.y}; }
    Point2D operator-(const Point2D& o) const { return {x - o.x, y - o.y}; }
    Point2D operator*(double s) const { return {x * s, y * s}; }
};

bool point_on_segment_2D(const Point2D& p, const Point2D& a, const Point2D& b, double& s) {
    Point2D ab = b - a;
    double lenSq = ab.x * ab.x + ab.y * ab.y;
    if (lenSq < 1e-16) return false;
    Point2D ap = p - a;
    double dot = ap.x * ab.x + ap.y * ab.y;
    s = dot / lenSq;
    if (s < -1e-8 || s > 1.0 + 1e-8) return false;
    double perp_x = ap.x - s * ab.x;
    double perp_y = ap.y - s * ab.y;
    double distSq = perp_x * perp_x + perp_y * perp_y;
    return distSq < 1e-12;
}

bool intersect_segments_2D(const Point2D& a, const Point2D& b, const Point2D& c, const Point2D& d, Point2D& out_p) {
    double denom = (b.x - a.x) * (d.y - c.y) - (b.y - a.y) * (d.x - c.x);
    if (std::abs(denom) < 1e-12) return false;
    
    double t = ((c.x - a.x) * (d.y - c.y) - (c.y - a.y) * (d.x - c.x)) / denom;
    double u = ((c.x - a.x) * (b.y - a.y) - (c.y - a.y) * (b.x - a.x)) / denom;
    
    if (t >= -1e-9 && t <= 1.0 + 1e-9 && u >= -1e-9 && u <= 1.0 + 1e-9) {
        out_p = a + (b - a) * std::max(0.0, std::min(1.0, t));
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool point_strictly_in_triangle_2D(const Point2D& p, const Point2D& a, const Point2D& b, const Point2D& c) {
    auto sign = [](const Point2D& p1, const Point2D& p2, const Point2D& p3) {
        return (p1.x - p3.x) * (p2.y - p3.y) - (p2.x - p3.x) * (p1.y - p3.y);
    };
    double d1 = sign(p, a, b);
    double d2 = sign(p, b, c);
    double d3 = sign(p, c, a);
    
    if (d1 > 1e-9 && d2 > 1e-9 && d3 > 1e-9) return true;
    if (d1 < -1e-9 && d2 < -1e-9 && d3 < -1e-9) return true;
    return false;
}

bool are_triangles_coplanar(const Triangle3D& T1, const Triangle3D& T2, const Point3D& N1, double d1) {
    Point3D N2 = (T2.p[1] - T2.p[0]).cross(T2.p[2] - T2.p[0]);
    double len2 = N2.norm();
    if (len2 < 1e-12) return false;
    N2 = N2 * (1.0 / len2);
    
    double cos_theta = std::abs(N1.dot(N2));
    if (cos_theta < 0.99999) return false;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        if (std::abs(T2.p[i].dot(N1) + d1) > 1e-7) return false;
    }
    return true;
}

void handle_coplanar_intersection(const Triangle3D& T1, const Triangle3D& T2,
                                  const Point3D& N1, double d1,
                                  std::vector<std::pair<Point3D, Point3D>>& new_constraints) {
    Point3D U;
    if (std::abs(N1.x) > 0.9) {
        U = Point3D{0.0, 1.0, 0.0}.cross(N1);
    } else {
        U = Point3D{1.0, 0.0, 0.0}.cross(N1);
    }
    U = U * (1.0 / U.norm());
    Point3D V = N1.cross(U);
    
    auto proj = [&](const Point3D& P) -> Point2D {
        return {P.dot(U), P.dot(V)};
    };
    auto unproj = [&](const Point2D& p2) -> Point3D {
        return U * p2.x + V * p2.y - N1 * d1;
    };
    
    Point2D p1[3] = {proj(T1.p[0]), proj(T1.p[1]), proj(T1.p[2])};
    Point2D p2[3] = {proj(T2.p[0]), proj(T2.p[1]), proj(T2.p[2])};
    
    for (int e1 = 0; e1 < 3; ++e1) {
        Point2D a = p1[e1];
        Point2D b = p1[(e1 + 1) % 3];
        
        std::vector<Point2D> pts_on_edge;
        pts_on_edge.push_back(a);
        pts_on_edge.push_back(b);
        
        for (int e2 = 0; e2 < 3; ++e2) {
            Point2D c = p2[e2];
            Point2D d = p2[(e2 + 1) % 3];
            Point2D ip;
            if (intersect_segments_2D(a, b, c, d, ip)) {
                pts_on_edge.push_back(ip);
            }
        }
        
        std::vector<Point2D> unique_pts;
        for (const auto& p : pts_on_edge) {
            bool duplicate = false;
            for (const auto& up : unique_pts) {
                double dx = p.x - up.x;
                double dy = p.y - up.y;
                if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 1e-16) { duplicate = true; break; }
            }
            if (!duplicate) unique_pts.push_back(p);
        }
        
        Point2D ab = b - a;
        std::sort(unique_pts.begin(), unique_pts.end(), [&](const Point2D& x, const Point2D& y) {
            double sx = (x - a).x * ab.x + (x - a).y * ab.y;
            double sy = (y - a).x * ab.x + (y - a).y * ab.y;
            return sx < sy;
        });
        
        for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < unique_pts.size(); ++i) {
            Point2D m = (unique_pts[i] + unique_pts[i + 1]) * 0.5;
            if (point_strictly_in_triangle_2D(m, p2[0], p2[1], p2[2])) {
                new_constraints.push_back({unproj(unique_pts[i]), unproj(unique_pts[i + 1])});
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int e2 = 0; e2 < 3; ++e2) {
        Point2D a = p2[e2];
        Point2D b = p2[(e2 + 1) % 3];
        
        std::vector<Point2D> pts_on_edge;
        pts_on_edge.push_back(a);
        pts_on_edge.push_back(b);
        
        for (int e1 = 0; e1 < 3; ++e1) {
            Point2D c = p1[e1];
            Point2D d = p1[(e1 + 1) % 3];
            Point2D ip;
            if (intersect_segments_2D(a, b, c, d, ip)) {
                pts_on_edge.push_back(ip);
            }
        }
        
        std::vector<Point2D> unique_pts;
        for (const auto& p : pts_on_edge) {
            bool duplicate = false;
            for (const auto& up : unique_pts) {
                double dx = p.x - up.x;
                double dy = p.y - up.y;
                if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 1e-16) { duplicate = true; break; }
            }
            if (!duplicate) unique_pts.push_back(p);
        }
        
        Point2D ab = b - a;
        std::sort(unique_pts.begin(), unique_pts.end(), [&](const Point2D& x, const Point2D& y) {
            double sx = (x - a).x * ab.x + (x - a).y * ab.y;
            double sy = (y - a).x * ab.x + (y - a).y * ab.y;
            return sx < sy;
        });
        
        for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < unique_pts.size(); ++i) {
            Point2D m = (unique_pts[i] + unique_pts[i + 1]) * 0.5;
            if (point_strictly_in_triangle_2D(m, p1[0], p1[1], p1[2])) {
                new_constraints.push_back({unproj(unique_pts[i]), unproj(unique_pts[i + 1])});
            }
        }
    }
}

struct Triangle {
    int v[3];
};

std::vector<Triangle> triangulate_polygon_2D(const std::vector<int>& poly, const std::vector<Point2D>& pts) {
    std::vector<Triangle> tris;
    std::vector<int> active = poly;
    
    auto is_convex = [&](int prev, int curr, int next) {
        Point2D a = pts[prev];
        Point2D b = pts[curr];
        Point2D c = pts[next];
        double area = (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - a.y) - (c.x - a.x) * (b.y - a.y);
        return area > 1e-12;
    };
    
    auto point_in_triangle = [&](const Point2D& p, const Point2D& a, const Point2D& b, const Point2D& c) {
        auto sign = [](const Point2D& p1, const Point2D& p2, const Point2D& p3) {
            return (p1.x - p3.x) * (p2.y - p3.y) - (p2.x - p3.x) * (p1.y - p3.y);
        };
        double d1 = sign(p, a, b);
        double d2 = sign(p, b, c);
        double d3 = sign(p, c, a);
        bool has_neg = (d1 < -1e-12) || (d2 < -1e-12) || (d3 < -1e-12);
        bool has_pos = (d1 > 1e-12) || (d2 > 1e-12) || (d3 > 1e-12);
        return !(has_neg && has_pos);
    };

    int n = active.size();
    int count = 0;
    while (n > 3 && count < 2 * n) {
        bool clipped = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            int prev = active[(i - 1 + n) % n];
            int curr = active[i];
            int next = active[(i + 1) % n];
            
            if (is_convex(prev, curr, next)) {
                bool has_point_inside = false;
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (active[j] == prev || active[j] == curr || active[j] == next) continue;
                    if (point_in_triangle(pts[active[j]], pts[prev], pts[curr], pts[next])) {
                        has_point_inside = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (!has_point_inside) {
                    tris.push_back({prev, curr, next});
                    active.erase(active.begin() + i);
                    n = active.size();
                    clipped = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!clipped) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                int prev = active[(i - 1 + n) % n];
                int curr = active[i];
                int next = active[(i + 1) % n];
                if (is_convex(prev, curr, next)) {
                    tris.push_back({prev, curr, next});
                    active.erase(active.begin() + i);
                    n = active.size();
                    clipped = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!clipped) {
                tris.push_back({active[0], active[1], active[2]});
                active.erase(active.begin() + 1);
                n = active.size();
            }
        }
        count++;
    }
    if (n == 3) {
        tris.push_back({active[0], active[1], active[2]});
    }
    return tris;
}

std::vector<std::array<Point3D, 3>> triangulate_face_with_constraints(
    const Triangle3D& T,
    const std::vector<std::pair<Point3D, Point3D>>& constraints)
{


    Point3D N = (T.p[1] - T.p[0]).cross(T.p[2] - T.p[0]);
    double area3D = N.norm();
    if (area3D < 1e-12) return {};
    N = N * (1.0 / area3D);
    
    Point3D U;
    if (std::abs(N.x) > 0.9) {
        U = Point3D{0.0, 1.0, 0.0}.cross(N);
    } else {
        U = Point3D{1.0, 0.0, 0.0}.cross(N);
    }
    U = U * (1.0 / U.norm());
    Point3D V = N.cross(U);
    double plane_d = T.p[0].dot(N);
    
    auto proj = [&](const Point3D& P) -> Point2D {
        return {P.dot(U), P.dot(V)};
    };
    auto unproj = [&](const Point2D& p2) -> Point3D {
        return U * p2.x + V * p2.y + N * plane_d;
    };
    
    std::vector<Point2D> pts2d;
    pts2d.push_back(proj(T.p[0]));
    pts2d.push_back(proj(T.p[1]));
    pts2d.push_back(proj(T.p[2]));
    
    for (const auto& c : constraints) {
        pts2d.push_back(proj(c.first));
        pts2d.push_back(proj(c.second));
    }
    
    std::vector<Point2D> unique_pts;
    std::vector<int> map_to_unique(pts2d.size(), -1);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)pts2d.size(); ++i) {
        int found = -1;
        for (int j = 0; j < (int)unique_pts.size(); ++j) {
            double dx = unique_pts[j].x - pts2d[i].x;
            double dy = unique_pts[j].y - pts2d[i].y;
            if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 1e-16) {
                found = j;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (found == -1) {
            found = unique_pts.size();
            unique_pts.push_back(pts2d[i]);
        }
        map_to_unique[i] = found;
    }
    

    
    int v0_idx = map_to_unique[0];
    int v1_idx = map_to_unique[1];
    int v2_idx = map_to_unique[2];
    
    struct SimpleEdge {
        int u, v;
        bool operator==(const SimpleEdge& o) const {
            return (u == o.u && v == o.v) || (u == o.v && v == o.u);
        }
    };
    std::vector<SimpleEdge> edges;
    auto add_edge_unique = [&](int u, int v) {
        if (u == v) return;
        SimpleEdge e{std::min(u, v), std::max(u, v)};
        for (const auto& existing : edges) {
            if (existing == e) return;
        }
        edges.push_back(e);
    };
    
    std::vector<std::vector<std::pair<double, int>>> edge_splits(3);
    edge_splits[0].push_back({0.0, v0_idx});
    edge_splits[0].push_back({1.0, v1_idx});
    edge_splits[1].push_back({0.0, v1_idx});
    edge_splits[1].push_back({1.0, v2_idx});
    edge_splits[2].push_back({0.0, v2_idx});
    edge_splits[2].push_back({1.0, v0_idx});
    
    for (int idx = 3; idx < (int)pts2d.size(); ++idx) {
        int pt_idx = map_to_unique[idx];
        if (pt_idx == v0_idx || pt_idx == v1_idx || pt_idx == v2_idx) continue;
        
        Point2D p = unique_pts[pt_idx];
        for (int e = 0; e < 3; ++e) {
            int a_idx = (e == 0) ? v0_idx : ((e == 1) ? v1_idx : v2_idx);
            int b_idx = (e == 0) ? v1_idx : ((e == 1) ? v2_idx : v0_idx);
            Point2D a = unique_pts[a_idx];
            Point2D b = unique_pts[b_idx];
            
            double s;
            if (point_on_segment_2D(p, a, b, s)) {
                edge_splits[e].push_back({s, pt_idx});
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int e = 0; e < 3; ++e) {
        auto& splits = edge_splits[e];
        std::sort(splits.begin(), splits.end());
        std::vector<std::pair<double, int>> unique_splits;
        for (const auto& sp : splits) {
            if (unique_splits.empty() || sp.first - unique_splits.back().first > 1e-8) {
                unique_splits.push_back(sp);
            }
        }
        for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < unique_splits.size(); ++i) {
            add_edge_unique(unique_splits[i].second, unique_splits[i + 1].second);
        }
    }
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < constraints.size(); ++i) {
        int u = map_to_unique[3 + 2 * i];
        int v = map_to_unique[3 + 2 * i + 1];
        add_edge_unique(u, v);
    }
    

    
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> adj(unique_pts.size());
    for (const auto& e : edges) {
        adj[e.u].push_back(e.v);
        adj[e.v].push_back(e.u);
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)unique_pts.size(); ++i) {
        Point2D base = unique_pts[i];
        std::sort(adj[i].begin(), adj[i].end(), [&](int a, int b) {
            Point2D va = unique_pts[a] - base;
            Point2D vb = unique_pts[b] - base;
            double ang_a = std::atan2(va.y, va.x);
            double ang_b = std::atan2(vb.y, vb.x);
            return ang_a < ang_b;
        });
    }
    
    struct HashEdge {
        size_t operator()(const std::pair<int, int>& p) const {
            return std::hash<int>()(p.first) ^ std::hash<int>()(p.second);
        }
    };
    std::unordered_set<std::pair<int, int>, HashEdge> visited;
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> CCW_faces;
    
    for (const auto& edge : edges) {
        for (int step = 0; step < 2; ++step) {
            int start_u = (step == 0) ? edge.u : edge.v;
            int start_v = (step == 0) ? edge.v : edge.u;
            
            if (visited.count({start_u, start_v})) continue;
            
            std::vector<int> face;
            face.push_back(start_u);
            
            int curr = start_v;
            int prev = start_u;
            bool ok = true;
            
            while (curr != start_u) {
                face.push_back(curr);
                visited.insert({prev, curr});
                
                const auto& neighbors = adj[curr];
                auto it = std::find(neighbors.begin(), neighbors.end(), prev);
                if (it == neighbors.end()) { ok = false; break; }
                
                int idx = std::distance(neighbors.begin(), it);
                int next_idx = (idx - 1 + neighbors.size()) % neighbors.size();
                int next_v = neighbors[next_idx];
                
                prev = curr;
                curr = next_v;
                
                if (face.size() > unique_pts.size() * 2) { ok = false; break; }
            }
            if (ok) {
                visited.insert({prev, curr});
                double area = 0.0;
                int n = face.size();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                    Point2D p1 = unique_pts[face[i]];
                    Point2D p2 = unique_pts[face[(i + 1) % n]];
                    area += p1.x * p2.y - p2.x * p1.y;
                }
                if (area > 1e-12) {
                    CCW_faces.push_back(face);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    std::vector<std::array<Point3D, 3>> result_triangles;
    for (const auto& face : CCW_faces) {
        if (face.size() < 3) continue;
        auto tris = triangulate_polygon_2D(face, unique_pts);
        for (const auto& tri : tris) {
            result_triangles.push_back({
                unproj(unique_pts[tri.v[0]]),
                unproj(unique_pts[tri.v[1]]),
                unproj(unique_pts[tri.v[2]])
            });
        }
    }
    

    
    return result_triangles;
}

void deduplicate_constraints(std::vector<std::pair<Point3D, Point3D>>& constraints) {
    std::vector<std::pair<Point3D, Point3D>> unique_c;
    for (const auto& c : constraints) {
        Point3D p1 = c.first;
        Point3D p2 = c.second;
        if (p2.x < p1.x || (p2.x == p1.x && p2.y < p1.y) || (p2.x == p1.x && p2.y == p1.y && p2.z < p1.z)) {
            std::swap(p1, p2);
        }
        
        bool duplicate = false;
        for (const auto& uc : unique_c) {
            if ((p1 - uc.first).normSq() < 1e-16 && (p2 - uc.second).normSq() < 1e-16) {
                duplicate = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!duplicate) {
            unique_c.push_back({p1, p2});
        }
    }
    constraints = unique_c;
}

bool is_point_inside_mesh(const Point3D& p, const Mesh& mesh, const BVH& bvh) {
    std::mt19937 gen(42);
    std::uniform_real_distribution<double> dis(-1.0, 1.0);
    
    for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 5; ++attempt) {
        Point3D dir = {1.0, 0.0, 0.0};
        if (attempt > 0) {
            dir = {dis(gen), dis(gen), dis(gen)};
            double len = dir.norm();
            if (len > 1e-6) {
                dir = dir * (1.0 / len);
            } else {
                dir = {1.0, 0.0, 0.0};
            }
        }
        
        std::vector<double> t_values;
        bool edge_hit = false;
        
        auto intersect_callback = [&](int face_idx) {
            const auto& F = mesh.faces[face_idx];
            Point3D v0 = mesh.vertices[F.v[0]];
            Point3D v1 = mesh.vertices[F.v[1]];
            Point3D v2 = mesh.vertices[F.v[2]];
            
            Point3D edge1 = v1 - v0;
            Point3D edge2 = v2 - v0;
            Point3D h = dir.cross(edge2);
            double a = edge1.dot(h);
            if (std::abs(a) < 1e-12) return;
            
            double f = 1.0 / a;
            Point3D s = p - v0;
            double u = f * s.dot(h);
            if (u < -1e-9 || u > 1.0 + 1e-9) return;
            
            Point3D q = s.cross(edge1);
            double v = f * dir.dot(q);
            if (v < -1e-9 || u + v > 1.0 + 1e-9) return;
            
            double t = f * edge2.dot(q);
            if (t > 1e-9) {
                if (u < 1e-9 || v < 1e-9 || (1.0 - u - v) < 1e-9) {
                    edge_hit = true;
                }
                t_values.push_back(t);
            }
        };
        
        bvh.intersect_ray(p, dir, intersect_callback);
        
        if (edge_hit) {
            continue;
        }
        
        std::sort(t_values.begin(), t_values.end());
        int unique_count = 0;
        double last_t = -1.0;
        for (double t : t_values) {
            if (last_t < 0 || t - last_t > 1e-9) {
                unique_count++;
                last_t = t;
            }
        }
        
        return (unique_count % 2) == 1;
    }
    
    return false;
}

std::vector<std::vector<int>> build_face_adjacency(const Mesh& mesh) {
    struct Edge {
        int u, v;
        bool operator==(const Edge& o) const {
            return u == o.u && v == o.v;
        }
    };
    struct EdgeHash {
        size_t operator()(const Edge& e) const {
            return std::hash<int>()(e.u) ^ std::hash<int>()(e.v);
        }
    };
    
    std::unordered_map<Edge, std::vector<int>, EdgeHash> edge_to_faces;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)mesh.faces.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& F = mesh.faces[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; ++j) {
            int u = F.v[j];
            int v = F.v[(j + 1) % 3];
            edge_to_faces[Edge{std::min(u, v), std::max(u, v)}].push_back(i);
        }
    }
    
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> adj(mesh.faces.size());
    for (const auto& pair : edge_to_faces) {
        const auto& faces = pair.second;
        if (faces.size() == 2) {
            adj[faces[0]].push_back(faces[1]);
            adj[faces[1]].push_back(faces[0]);
        }
    }
    return adj;
}

struct GridMerge {
    double eps = 1e-8;
    struct BucketKey {
        long long x, y, z;
        bool operator==(const BucketKey& o) const {
            return x == o.x && y == o.y && z == o.z;
        }
    };
    struct BucketKeyHash {
        size_t operator()(const BucketKey& k) const {
            return (k.x * 73856093) ^ (k.y * 19349663) ^ (k.z * 83492791);
        }
    };
    
    std::unordered_map<BucketKey, std::vector<int>, BucketKeyHash> grid;
    std::vector<Point3D> unique_vertices;
    
    int get_or_create_vertex(const Point3D& p) {
        long long bx = (long long)std::floor(p.x / eps);
        long long by = (long long)std::floor(p.y / eps);
        long long bz = (long long)std::floor(p.z / eps);
        
        for (long long dx = -1; dx <= 1; ++dx) {
            for (long long dy = -1; dy <= 1; ++dy) {
                for (long long dz = -1; dz <= 1; ++dz) {
                    BucketKey key{bx + dx, by + dy, bz + dz};
                    auto it = grid.find(key);
                    if (it != grid.end()) {
                        for (int idx : it->second) {
                            const auto& candidate = unique_vertices[idx];
                            double dx_val = candidate.x - p.x;
                            double dy_val = candidate.y - p.y;
                            double dz_val = candidate.z - p.z;
                            if (dx_val * dx_val + dy_val * dy_val + dz_val * dz_val < eps * eps) {
                                return idx;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int new_idx = unique_vertices.size();
        unique_vertices.push_back(p);
        grid[BucketKey{bx, by, bz}].push_back(new_idx);
        return new_idx;
    }
};

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(NULL);
    
    std::cerr << "Reading input..." << std::endl;
    FastInput in;
    int VA = in.read_int();
    int FA = in.read_int();
    int VB = in.read_int();
    int FB = in.read_int();
    std::cerr << "VA=" << VA << " FA=" << FA << " VB=" << VB << " FB=" << FB << std::endl;
    
    Mesh meshA, meshB;
    meshA.vertices.resize(VA);
    meshA.faces.resize(FA);
    meshB.vertices.resize(VB);
    meshB.faces.resize(FB);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < VA; ++i) {
        meshA.vertices[i].x = in.read_double();
        meshA.vertices[i].y = in.read_double();
        meshA.vertices[i].z = in.read_double();
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < FA; ++i) {
        meshA.faces[i].v[0] = in.read_int();
        meshA.faces[i].v[1] = in.read_int();
        meshA.faces[i].v[2] = in.read_int();
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < VB; ++i) {
        meshB.vertices[i].x = in.read_double();
        meshB.vertices[i].y = in.read_double();
        meshB.vertices[i].z = in.read_double();
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < FB; ++i) {
        meshB.faces[i].v[0] = in.read_int();
        meshB.faces[i].v[1] = in.read_int();
        meshB.faces[i].v[2] = in.read_int();
    }
    std::cerr << "Input read successfully." << std::endl;
    
    // Build BVHs
    std::cerr << "Building BVH A..." << std::endl;
    BVH bvhA;
    bvhA.build(meshA);
    std::cerr << "Building BVH B..." << std::endl;
    BVH bvhB;
    bvhB.build(meshB);
    
    // Find intersecting face pairs
    std::cerr << "Finding candidate pairs..." << std::endl;
    std::vector<std::pair<int, int>> candidate_pairs;
    if (bvhA.root != -1 && bvhB.root != -1) {
        intersect_bvhs(meshA, bvhA, bvhA.root, meshB, bvhB, bvhB.root, candidate_pairs);
    }
    std::cerr << "Candidate pairs count: " << candidate_pairs.size() << std::endl;
    
    std::vector<bool> I_A(FA, false);
    std::vector<bool> I_B(FB, false);
    std::vector<bool> B_coplanar_same_normal(FB, false);
    std::vector<std::vector<std::pair<Point3D, Point3D>>> segments_on_A(FA);
    std::vector<std::vector<std::pair<Point3D, Point3D>>> segments_on_B(FB);
    
    for (const auto& pair : candidate_pairs) {
        int i = pair.first;
        int j = pair.second;
        
        const auto& FA_face = meshA.faces[i];
        Triangle3D T1 = {meshA.vertices[FA_face.v[0]], meshA.vertices[FA_face.v[1]], meshA.vertices[FA_face.v[2]]};
        
        const auto& FB_face = meshB.faces[j];
        Triangle3D T2 = {meshB.vertices[FB_face.v[0]], meshB.vertices[FB_face.v[1]], meshB.vertices[FB_face.v[2]]};
        
        Point3D N1 = (T1.p[1] - T1.p[0]).cross(T1.p[2] - T1.p[0]);
        double len1 = N1.norm();
        if (len1 < 1e-12) continue;
        N1 = N1 * (1.0 / len1);
        double d1 = -N1.dot(T1.p[0]);
        
        if (are_triangles_coplanar(T1, T2, N1, d1)) {
            // Check if normals point in the same direction
            Point3D N2 = (T2.p[1] - T2.p[0]).cross(T2.p[2] - T2.p[0]);
            double len2 = N2.norm();
            if (len2 > 1e-12) {
                N2 = N2 * (1.0 / len2);
                if (N1.dot(N2) > 0.9) {
                    B_coplanar_same_normal[j] = true;
                }
            }
            std::vector<std::pair<Point3D, Point3D>> coplanar_constraints;
            handle_coplanar_intersection(T1, T2, N1, d1, coplanar_constraints);
            if (!coplanar_constraints.empty()) {
                I_A[i] = true;
                I_B[j] = true;
                for (const auto& c : coplanar_constraints) {
                    segments_on_A[i].push_back(c);
                    segments_on_B[j].push_back(c);
                }
            }
        } else {
            Point3D pStart, pEnd;
            if (intersect_triangles(T1, T2, pStart, pEnd)) {
                I_A[i] = true;
                I_B[j] = true;
                segments_on_A[i].push_back({pStart, pEnd});
                segments_on_B[j].push_back({pStart, pEnd});
            }
        }
    }
    
    std::vector<std::array<Point3D, 3>> kept_triangles;
    
    // Process intersecting faces of A
    for (int i = 0; i < FA; ++i) {
        if (I_A[i]) {
            deduplicate_constraints(segments_on_A[i]);
            const auto& F = meshA.faces[i];
            Triangle3D T = {meshA.vertices[F.v[0]], meshA.vertices[F.v[1]], meshA.vertices[F.v[2]]};
            Point3D N = (T.p[1] - T.p[0]).cross(T.p[2] - T.p[0]);
            double len = N.norm();
            if (len > 1e-12) N = N * (1.0 / len);
            
            auto sub_tris = triangulate_face_with_constraints(T, segments_on_A[i]);
            for (const auto& sub_t : sub_tris) {
                Point3D centroid = (sub_t[0] + sub_t[1] + sub_t[2]) * (1.0 / 3.0);
                Point3D test_pt = centroid + N * 1e-8;
                bool insideB = is_point_inside_mesh(test_pt, meshB, bvhB);

                if (!insideB) {
                    kept_triangles.push_back(sub_t);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Process intersecting faces of B
    for (int j = 0; j < FB; ++j) {
        if (I_B[j]) {
            deduplicate_constraints(segments_on_B[j]);
            const auto& F = meshB.faces[j];
            Triangle3D T = {meshB.vertices[F.v[0]], meshB.vertices[F.v[1]], meshB.vertices[F.v[2]]};
            Point3D N = (T.p[1] - T.p[0]).cross(T.p[2] - T.p[0]);
            double len = N.norm();
            if (len > 1e-12) N = N * (1.0 / len);
            
            auto sub_tris = triangulate_face_with_constraints(T, segments_on_B[j]);
            double perturb_sign = B_coplanar_same_normal[j] ? -1.0 : 1.0;
            for (const auto& sub_t : sub_tris) {
                Point3D centroid = (sub_t[0] + sub_t[1] + sub_t[2]) * (1.0 / 3.0);
                Point3D test_pt = centroid + N * (perturb_sign * 1e-8);
                if (!is_point_inside_mesh(test_pt, meshA, bvhA)) {
                    kept_triangles.push_back(sub_t);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    std::cerr << "Classifying non-intersecting faces of A..." << std::endl;
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> adjA = build_face_adjacency(meshA);
    std::vector<bool> visitedA(FA, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < FA; ++i) {
        if (I_A[i] || visitedA[i]) continue;
        
        std::vector<int> component;
        std::queue<int> q;
        q.push(i);
        visitedA[i] = true;
        
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int curr = q.front();
            q.pop();
            component.push_back(curr);
            
            for (int neighbor : adjA[curr]) {
                if (!I_A[neighbor] && !visitedA[neighbor]) {
                    visitedA[neighbor] = true;
                    q.push(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int rep = component[0];
        const auto& F = meshA.faces[rep];
        Point3D centroid = (meshA.vertices[F.v[0]] + meshA.vertices[F.v[1]] + meshA.vertices[F.v[2]]) * (1.0 / 3.0);
        Point3D N = (meshA.vertices[F.v[1]] - meshA.vertices[F.v[0]]).cross(meshA.vertices[F.v[2]] - meshA.vertices[F.v[0]]);
        double len = N.norm();
        if (len > 1e-12) N = N * (1.0 / len);
        Point3D test_pt = centroid + N * 1e-8;
        
        if (!is_point_inside_mesh(test_pt, meshB, bvhB)) {
            for (int idx : component) {
                const auto& F_comp = meshA.faces[idx];
                kept_triangles.push_back({
                    meshA.vertices[F_comp.v[0]],
                    meshA.vertices[F_comp.v[1]],
                    meshA.vertices[F_comp.v[2]]
                });
            }
        }
    }
    
    std::cerr << "Classifying non-intersecting faces of B..." << std::endl;
    std::vector<std::vector<int>> adjB = build_face_adjacency(meshB);
    std::vector<bool> visitedB(FB, false);
    for (int j = 0; j < FB; ++j) {
        if (I_B[j] || visitedB[j]) continue;
        
        std::vector<int> component;
        std::queue<int> q;
        q.push(j);
        visitedB[j] = true;
        
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int curr = q.front();
            q.pop();
            component.push_back(curr);
            
            for (int neighbor : adjB[curr]) {
                if (!I_B[neighbor] && !visitedB[neighbor]) {
                    visitedB[neighbor] = true;
                    q.push(neighbor);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int rep = component[0];
        const auto& F = meshB.faces[rep];
        Point3D centroid = (meshB.vertices[F.v[0]] + meshB.vertices[F.v[1]] + meshB.vertices[F.v[2]]) * (1.0 / 3.0);
        Point3D N = (meshB.vertices[F.v[1]] - meshB.vertices[F.v[0]]).cross(meshB.vertices[F.v[2]] - meshB.vertices[F.v[0]]);
        double len = N.norm();
        if (len > 1e-12) N = N * (1.0 / len);
        Point3D test_pt = centroid + N * 1e-8;
        
        if (!is_point_inside_mesh(test_pt, meshA, bvhA)) {
            for (int idx : component) {
                const auto& F_comp = meshB.faces[idx];
                kept_triangles.push_back({
                    meshB.vertices[F_comp.v[0]],
                    meshB.vertices[F_comp.v[1]],
                    meshB.vertices[F_comp.v[2]]
                });
            }
        }
    }
    
    std::cerr << "Merging vertices. Kept count: " << kept_triangles.size() << std::endl;
    GridMerge merger;
    merger.grid.reserve(kept_triangles.size() * 3);
    
    struct IndexedTriangle {
        int v[3];
        int original_parity;
    };
    std::vector<IndexedTriangle> indexed_triangles;
    indexed_triangles.reserve(kept_triangles.size());
    
    for (const auto& t : kept_triangles) {
        int idx0 = merger.get_or_create_vertex(t[0]);
        int idx1 = merger.get_or_create_vertex(t[1]);
        int idx2 = merger.get_or_create_vertex(t[2]);
        if (idx0 == idx1 || idx1 == idx2 || idx2 == idx0) continue;
        
        int s0 = idx0, s1 = idx1, s2 = idx2;
        int parity = 1;
        if (s0 > s1) { std::swap(s0, s1); parity = -parity; }
        if (s1 > s2) { std::swap(s1, s2); parity = -parity; }
        if (s0 > s1) { std::swap(s0, s1); parity = -parity; }
        
        indexed_triangles.push_back({ {idx0, idx1, idx2}, parity });
    }
    
    struct TriSignature {
        int v[3];
        bool operator==(const TriSignature& o) const {
            return v[0] == o.v[0] && v[1] == o.v[1] && v[2] == o.v[2];
        }
    };
    struct TriSigHash {
        size_t operator()(const TriSignature& ts) const {
            return std::hash<int>()(ts.v[0]) ^ std::hash<int>()(ts.v[1]) ^ std::hash<int>()(ts.v[2]);
        }
    };
    
    std::unordered_map<TriSignature, std::vector<IndexedTriangle>, TriSigHash> groups;
    for (const auto& itri : indexed_triangles) {
        int s[3] = {itri.v[0], itri.v[1], itri.v[2]};
        std::sort(s, s + 3);
        groups[TriSignature{ {s[0], s[1], s[2]} }].push_back(itri);
    }
    
    std::vector<Face> final_faces;
    for (const auto& pair : groups) {
        const auto& list = pair.second;
        if (list.size() == 1) {
            final_faces.push_back({ {list[0].v[0], list[0].v[1], list[0].v[2]} });
        } else if (list.size() >= 2) {
            int sum_parity = 0;
            for (const auto& item : list) {
                sum_parity += item.original_parity;
            }
            if (sum_parity > 0) {
                for (const auto& item : list) {
                    if (item.original_parity == 1) {
                        final_faces.push_back({ {item.v[0], item.v[1], item.v[2]} });
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } else if (sum_parity < 0) {
                for (const auto& item : list) {
                    if (item.original_parity == -1) {
                        final_faces.push_back({ {item.v[0], item.v[1], item.v[2]} });
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Write output
    FastOutput out;
    out.write_int((long long)merger.unique_vertices.size());
    out.write_space();
    out.write_int((long long)final_faces.size());
    out.write_newline();
    
    for (const auto& v : merger.unique_vertices) {
        out.write_double(v.x);
        out.write_space();
        out.write_double(v.y);
        out.write_space();
        out.write_double(v.z);
        out.write_newline();
    }
    for (const auto& f : final_faces) {
        out.write_int((long long)f.v[0]);
        out.write_space();
        out.write_int((long long)f.v[1]);
        out.write_space();
        out.write_int((long long)f.v[2]);
        out.write_newline();
    }
    
    return 0;
}

use std::collections::VecDeque;
use std::io::{self, BufRead, Write};

fn write_usize<W: Write>(writer: &mut W, mut n: usize) -> io::Result<()> {
    if n == 0 {
        return writer.write_all(b"0");
    }
    let mut buf = [0u8; 20];
    let mut i = 20;
    while n > 0 {
        i -= 1;
        buf[i] = b'0' + (n % 10) as u8;
        n /= 10;
    }
    writer.write_all(&buf[i..])
}

fn write_coord<W: Write>(writer: &mut W, x: usize, y: usize) -> io::Result<()> {
    write_usize(writer, x)?;
    writer.write_all(b" ")?;
    write_usize(writer, y)?;
    writer.write_all(b"\n")
}

fn main() {
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut reader = io::BufReader::with_capacity(8 * 1024 * 1024, stdin.lock());

    let mut line = String::new();
    if reader.read_line(&mut line).is_err() {
        return;
    }
    let mut parts = line.split_whitespace();
    let h_str = match parts.next() {
        Some(s) => s,
        None => return,
    };
    let w_str = match parts.next() {
        Some(s) => s,
        None => return,
    };
    let H: usize = match h_str.parse() {
        Ok(v) => v,
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    let W: usize = match w_str.parse() {
        Ok(v) => v,
        Err(_) => return,
    };

    if H == 0 || W == 0 {
        return;
    }

    let mut grid = vec![0u8; H * W];
    let mut start_idx = None;
    let mut goal_idx = None;

    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(W + 2);
    for r in 0..H {
        buf.clear();
        if reader.read_until(b'\n', &mut buf).is_err() {
            return;
        }
        while buf.last() == Some(&b'\n') || buf.last() == Some(&b'\r') {
            buf.pop();
        }
        let start_offset = r * W;
        let len = buf.len().min(W);
        for c in 0..len {
            let val = buf[c];
            grid[start_offset + c] = val;
            if val == b'A' {
                start_idx = Some(start_offset + c);
            } else if val == b'B' {
                goal_idx = Some(start_offset + c);
            }
        }
        for c in len..W {
            grid[start_offset + c] = b' ';
        }
    }

    let start_idx = match start_idx {
        Some(idx) => idx,
        None => return,
    };
    let goal_idx = match goal_idx {
        Some(idx) => idx,
        None => return,
    };

    if start_idx == goal_idx {
        let mut writer = io::BufWriter::new(io::stdout().lock());
        writeln!(writer, "1").unwrap();
        let x = start_idx % W;
        let y = start_idx / W;
        let _ = write_coord(&mut writer, x, y);
        return;
    }

    let mut q_f = VecDeque::new();
    let mut q_b = VecDeque::new();

    let start_x = start_idx % W;
    let start_y = start_idx / W;
    let goal_x = goal_idx % W;
    let goal_y = goal_idx / W;

    q_f.push_back(((start_y as u64) << 32) | (start_x as u64));
    q_b.push_back(((goal_y as u64) << 32) | (goal_x as u64));

    let mut intersection = None;

    while !q_f.is_empty() && !q_b.is_empty() {
        if q_f.len() <= q_b.len() {
            let curr = q_f.pop_front().unwrap();
            let cx = (curr & 0xFFFFFFFF) as usize;
            let cy = (curr >> 32) as usize;
            let curr_idx = cy * W + cx;

                let val = grid[next_idx];
                if val != b'#' {
                    if val == b'B' || val == b'u' || val == b'd' || val == b'l' || val == b'r' {
                        intersection = Some((curr_idx, next_idx));
                        break;
                    } else if val == b' ' {

                let val = grid[next_idx];
                if val != b'#' {
                    if val == b'B' || val == b'u' || val == b'd' || val == b'l' || val == b'r' {
                        intersection = Some((curr_idx, next_idx));
                        break;
                    } else if val == b' ' {

                        q_f.push_back((((cy + 1) as u64) << 32) | (cx as u64));

                if val != b'#' {

                    } else if val == b' ' {

            // RIGHT
            if cx + 1 < W {
                let next_idx = curr_idx + 1;
                let val = grid[next_idx];
                if val != b'#' {

                    } else if val == b' ' {

                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            let curr = q_b.pop_front().unwrap();
            let cx = (curr & 0xFFFFFFFF) as usize;
            let cy = (curr >> 32) as usize;
            let curr_idx = cy * W + cx;

            if cy > 0 {

                        q_b.push_back((((cy - 1) as u64) << 32) | (cx as u64));

                }
            }

            if cy + 1 < H {
                let next_idx = curr_idx + W;
                let val = grid[next_idx];
                if val != b'#' {
                    if val == b'A' || val == b'U' || val == b'D' || val == b'L' || val == b'R' {
                        intersection = Some((next_idx, curr_idx));
                        break;
                    } else if val == b' ' {
                        grid[next_idx] = b'u';
                        q_b.push_back((((cy + 1) as u64) << 32) | (cx as u64));

            // LEFT
