HLSL Shader - Horizontal Stripes

View HLSL (1647 chars)
struct PSInput {
    [[vk::location(0)]] float3 worldPos : TEXCOORD0;   // world-space position
    [[vk::location(1)]] float3 normal   : TEXCOORD1;   // world-space normal (interpolated, may need normalize)
    [[vk::location(2)]] float2 uv       : TEXCOORD2;   // texture coordinates in [0,1]
    [[vk::location(3)]] float3 tangent  : TEXCOORD3;   // tangent vector
    [[vk::location(4)]] float3 color    : TEXCOORD4;   // per-vertex color (smoothly varies: rgb = 0.5+0.5*xyz)
};

[[vk::binding(0, 0)]]
cbuffer UBO : register(b0) {
    float4x4 model;          // offset 0   (column-major)
    float4x4 view;           // offset 64
    float4x4 projection;     // offset 128
    float4 lightPos;         // value: (5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 1.0)
    float4 cameraPos;        // value: (0.0, 0.0, 3.0, 1.0)
    float4 params;           // value: (0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0)
};

float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_Target0
{
    // Normalize world-space normal
    float3 N = normalize(input.normal);
    
    // Light direction (from surface to light source)
    float3 L = normalize(lightPos.xyz - input.worldPos);
    
    // Lambertian diffuse
    float diffuse = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
    
    // Half-Lambert/Lambertian shading factor
    float factor = 0.4 + 0.6 * diffuse;
    
    // Calculate stripe pattern based on uv.y
    float stripeVal = sin(input.uv.y * 3.14159 * 16.0);
    
    // Alternate red (0.9, 0.1, 0.1) and blue (0.1, 0.1, 0.9)
    float3 stripeColor = (stripeVal >= 0.0) ? float3(0.9, 0.1, 0.1) : float3(0.1, 0.1, 0.9);
    
    // Combine shading factor and stripe color, outputting alpha 1.0
    return float4(stripeColor * factor, 1.0);
}

struct PSInput {
    [[vk::location(0)]] float3 worldPos : TEXCOORD0;
    [[vk::location(1)]] float3 normal   : TEXCOORD1;
    [[vk::location(2)]] float2 uv       : TEXCOORD2;
    [[vk::location(3)]] float3 tangent  : TEXCOORD3;
    [[vk::location(4)]] float3 color    : TEXCOORD4;
};

[[vk::binding(0, 0)]]
cbuffer UBO : register(b0) {
    float4x4 model;
    float4x4 view;
    float4x4 projection;
    float4 lightPos;
    float4 cameraPos;
    float4 params;
};

float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_Target0
{
    float2 scaledUV = input.uv * 6.0;
    float2 cellUV = frac(scaledUV);
    
    float d = distance(cellUV, float2(0.5, 0.5));
    float3 baseColor = (d <= 0.3) ? float3(1.0, 0.8, 0.0) : float3(0.1, 0.1, 0.3);
    
    float3 N = normalize(input.normal);
    float3 L = normalize(lightPos.xyz - input.worldPos);
    
    float diffuse = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
    float factor = 0.3 + 0.7 * diffuse;
    
    float3 finalColor = baseColor * factor;
    
    return float4(finalColor, 1.0);
}

struct PSInput {
    [[vk::location(0)]] float3 worldPos : TEXCOORD0;   // world-space position
    [[vk::location(1)]] float3 normal   : TEXCOORD1;   // world-space normal (interpolated, may need normalize)
    [[vk::location(2)]] float2 uv       : TEXCOORD2;   // texture coordinates in [0,1]
    [[vk::location(3)]] float3 tangent  : TEXCOORD3;   // tangent vector
    [[vk::location(4)]] float3 color    : TEXCOORD4;   // per-vertex color (smoothly varies: rgb = 0.5+0.5*xyz)
};

[[vk::binding(0, 0)]]
cbuffer UBO : register(b0) {
    float4x4 model;          // offset 0   (column-major)
    float4x4 view;           // offset 64
    float4x4 projection;     // offset 128
    float4 lightPos;         // value: (5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 1.0)
    float4 cameraPos;        // value: (0.0, 0.0, 3.0, 1.0)
    float4 params;           // value: (0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0)
};

float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_Target0
{
    float3 N = normalize(input.normal);
    
    // Hemisphere ambient lighting
    float3 skyColor = float3(0.4, 0.6, 1.0);
    float3 groundColor = float3(0.3, 0.15, 0.05);
    float blend = N.y * 0.5 + 0.5;
    float3 ambient = lerp(groundColor, skyColor, blend);
    
    // Diffuse term
    float3 L = normalize(lightPos.xyz - input.worldPos);
    float d = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
    
    // Combine ambient and diffuse
    float3 finalColor = ambient + 0.3 * d;
    
    return float4(finalColor, 1.0);
}

    [[vk::location(1)]] float3 normal   : TEXCOORD1;   // world-space normal (interpolated, may need normalize)
    [[vk::location(2)]] float2 uv       : TEXCOORD2;   // texture coordinates in [0,1]
    [[vk::location(3)]] float3 tangent  : TEXCOORD3;   // tangent vector
    [[vk::location(4)]] float3 color    : TEXCOORD4;   // per-vertex color (smoothly varies: rgb = 0.5+0.5*xyz)
};

[[vk::binding(0, 0)]]
cbuffer UBO : register(b0) {
    float4x4 model;          // offset 0   (column-major)
    float4x4 view;           // offset 64
    float4x4 projection;     // offset 128
    float4 lightPos;         // value: (5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 1.0)
    float4 cameraPos;        // value: (0.0, 0.0, 3.0, 1.0)
    float4 params;           // value: (0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0)
};

float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_Target0
{
    float t = clamp(input.worldPos.y * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
    float3 col = lerp(float3(0.1, 0.4, 0.1), float3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0), t);

}

struct PSInput {
    [[vk::location(0)]] float3 worldPos : TEXCOORD0;
    [[vk::location(1)]] float3 normal   : TEXCOORD1;
    [[vk::location(2)]] float2 uv       : TEXCOORD2;
    [[vk::location(3)]] float3 tangent  : TEXCOORD3;
    [[vk::location(4)]] float3 color    : TEXCOORD4;
};

[[vk::binding(0, 0)]]
cbuffer UBO : register(b0) {
    float4x4 model;
    float4x4 view;
    float4x4 projection;
    float4 lightPos;
    float4 cameraPos;
    float4 params;
};

float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_Target0
{
    float2 c = float2(input.uv.x * 3.0f - 2.0f, input.uv.y * 2.0f - 1.0f);
    float2 z = float2(0.0f, 0.0f);
    float iterations = 0.0f;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++)
    {
        if (dot(z, z) > 4.0f)
        {
            break;
        }
        float x = z.x * z.x - z.y * z.y + c.x;
        float y = 2.0f * z.x * z.y + c.y;
        z = float2(x, y);
        iterations += 1.0f;
    }
    
    float t = iterations / 20.0f;
    return float4(t, t * 0.5f, 1.0f - t, 1.0f);
}

struct PSInput {
    [[vk::location(0)]] float3 worldPos : TEXCOORD0;   // world-space position
    [[vk::location(1)]] float3 normal   : TEXCOORD1;   // world-space normal (interpolated, may need normalize)
    [[vk::location(2)]] float2 uv       : TEXCOORD2;   // texture coordinates in [0,1]
    [[vk::location(3)]] float3 tangent  : TEXCOORD3;   // tangent vector
    [[vk::location(4)]] float3 color    : TEXCOORD4;   // per-vertex color (smoothly varies: rgb = 0.5+0.5*xyz)
};

[[vk::binding(0, 0)]]
cbuffer UBO : register(b0) {
    float4x4 model;          // offset 0   (column-major)
    float4x4 view;           // offset 64
    float4x4 projection;     // offset 128
    float4 lightPos;         // value: (5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 1.0)
    float4 cameraPos;        // value: (0.0, 0.0, 3.0, 1.0)
    float4 params;           // value: (0.0, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0)
};

float4 main(PSInput input) : SV_Target0 {
    float3 N = normalize(input.normal);
    float3 L = normalize(lightPos.xyz - input.worldPos);
    float3 V = normalize(cameraPos.xyz - input.worldPos);
    float3 R = reflect(-L, N);

    float3 ambient = float3(0.1, 0.05, 0.05);
    float3 diffuse = input.color * max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
    float3 specular = float3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0) * pow(max(dot(R, V), 0.0), 32.0);

    float3 sum = ambient + diffuse + specular;
    return float4(clamp(sum, 0.0, 1.0), 1.0);
}

layout(location = 0) out vec4 outColor;  // RGBA float, stored as rgba8unorm

void main() {
    // 8x8 frequency checkerboard
    vec2 checkUV = uv * 8.0;
    float parity = mod(floor(checkUV.x) + floor(checkUV.y), 2.0);
    float checkColor = (parity < 0.5) ? 0.9 : 0.2;

    // Lambertian shading
    vec3 N = normalize(normal);
    vec3 L = normalize(ubo.lightPos.xyz - worldPos);
    float diffuse = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);

    // Apply factor (0.5 + 0.5*diffuse)
    float factor = 0.5 + 0.5 * diffuse;

    outColor = vec4(vec3(checkColor) * factor, 1.0);
}

layout(location = 0) in vec3 worldPos;
layout(location = 1) in vec3 normal;
layout(location = 2) in vec2 uv;

layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform UBO {
    mat4 model;
    mat4 view;
    mat4 projection;
    vec4 lightPos;
    vec4 cameraPos;
    vec4 params;
} ubo;

layout(location = 0) out vec4 outColor;

void main() {
    // Normalize the interpolated normal vector
    vec3 N = normalize(normal);
    
    // Light direction vector from worldPos to light position
    vec3 L = normalize(ubo.lightPos.xyz - worldPos);
    
    // Diffuse shading term (Lambertian)
    float d = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
    
    // Ambient colors for the hemisphere model
    vec3 skyColor = vec3(0.4, 0.6, 1.0);
    vec3 groundColor = vec3(0.3, 0.15, 0.05);
    
    // Blending factor based on normalized surface normal's Y-coordinate
    float blend = N.y * 0.5 + 0.5;
    
    // Interpolate ambient lighting between ground and sky
    vec3 ambient = mix(groundColor, skyColor, blend);
    
    // Add the scaled diffuse term
    vec3 finalColor = ambient + 0.3 * d;
    
    // Output final color with opaque alpha
    outColor = vec4(finalColor, 1.0);
}

Typical Prompt:
You are writing a SPIR-V fragment shader as raw binary data, encoded as a hex string.
The binary will be decoded from hex, validated with spirv-val, and rendered on a unit sphere.

**SPIR-V Binary Format (little-endian 32-bit words):**
Each 32-bit word is 8 hex characters (little-endian byte order).

Header (5 words):
```
03022307 // Magic number 0x07230203 (little-endian)
00000100 // Version 1.0 (0x00010000)
00000000 // Generator (0 = manual)
BBBBBBBB // Bound (max ID + 1)
00000000 // Reserved
```

Instructions follow as: first word = (WordCount << 16) | Opcode, then operands.

**Key opcodes (decimal):**
- OpCapability (17): word_count=2, operand=capability (1=Shader)
- OpExtInstImport (11): result_id, name_string
- OpMemoryModel (14): word_count=3, addressing=0(Logical), model=1(GLSL450)
- OpEntryPoint (15): execution_model=4(Fragment), entry_id, name, interface_vars...
- OpExecutionMode (16): entry_id, mode=7(OriginUpperLeft)
- OpDecorate (71): target, decoration, operands
- OpTypeVoid (19), OpTypeFunction (33), OpTypeFloat (22), OpTypeVector (23)
- OpTypePointer (32), OpVariable (59), OpConstant (43)
- OpFunction (54), OpFunctionEnd (56), OpLabel (248)
- OpLoad (61), OpStore (62), OpReturn (253)
- OpCompositeConstruct (80), OpCompositeExtract (81)
- OpDot (148), OpFMul (133), OpFAdd (129), OpFSub (131), OpFNegate (127)
- OpExtInst (12): GLSL.std.450 ext instructions

**Decoration values:** Location=30, DescriptorSet=34, Binding=33, Block=2, Offset=35

**Available inputs (from vertex shader):**
```
location 0: vec3 worldPos
location 1: vec3 normal
location 2: vec2 uv
location 3: vec3 tangent
location 4: vec3 color
```

**UBO (set=0, binding=0):** mat4 model(0), mat4 view(64), mat4 projection(128),
vec4 lightPos(192), vec4 cameraPos(208), vec4 params(224).

**Required output:** location 0: vec4 outColor

**Write ONLY the complete hex string of the SPIR-V binary.** Each byte as two hex
characters, no spaces or newlines within the hex data. The hex string represents
the raw bytes of the .spv file.

Typical Prompt:
Write a GLSL compute shader for gravitational N-body simulation.

**GLSL Compute Shader Interface:**

```
#version 450

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

// Each body is stored as two consecutive vec4s:
// vec4(position.xyz, mass)
// vec4(velocity.xyz, 0.0)
// So body i starts at index i*2 in the buffer.

layout(set = 0, binding = 0) readonly buffer InputBodies {
vec4 inData[]; // length = N * 2
};

layout(set = 0, binding = 1) buffer OutputBodies {
vec4 outData[]; // length = N * 2
};

layout(set = 0, binding = 2) uniform Params {
uvec4 counts; // counts.x = N (number of bodies)
vec4 physics; // physics.x = dt, physics.y = softening, physics.z = G
};
```

**Task:** Write a compute shader that performs ONE timestep of gravitational
N-body simulation using the leapfrog/Euler integration method. Each invocation
handles one body (gl_GlobalInvocationID.x), reading its position and velocity
from inData and writing updated values to outData. The acceleration should be
computed from all other bodies using:

acc += G * mass_j * (pos_j - pos_i) / (|pos_j - pos_i|^2 + softening^2)^(3/2)

Velocity is advanced by acc * dt and position is advanced by vel * dt. The
shader will be dispatched ceil(N/256) workgroups in X and run multiple times
with ping-pong buffers for the required number of timesteps.

**Critical Requirements:**
- Guard against gl_GlobalInvocationID.x >= N
- Use the softening parameter to avoid singularities
- Skip self-interaction (i == j)
- Write BOTH position+mass and velocity vec4s to output

G = 0.006674 (scaled gravitational constant)

Test 47: Hash Mining / Proof of Work (WGSL Compute) Score: 0.00 / 5
Typical Prompt:
Write a WGSL compute shader for hash mining (proof-of-work).

**WGSL Compute Shader Interface:**

```wgsl
@group(0) @binding(0) var baseData : array;
@group(0) @binding(1) var result : array;
@group(0) @binding(2) var params : vec4;
// params.x = difficulty, params.y = range_start, params.z = range_size

@compute @workgroup_size(256)
fn main(@builtin(global_invocation_id) gid : vec3) { ... }
```

**Task:** Write a compute shader that searches for a uint32 nonce such that
the custom hash of (baseData XOR nonce) has at least `difficulty` trailing
zero bits in the 64-bit output.

**Hash function (MUST match exactly):**
```
function custom_hash(data[16], nonce) -> (h0, h1):
state[0..15] = data[0..15]
for i in 0..15: state[i] ^= (nonce + i)

// 8 rounds of quarter-round mixing (ChaCha-like)
repeat 8 times:
for each group of 4 consecutive elements (i, i+1, i+2, i+3):
a += b; d ^= a; d = rotl(d, 16)
c += d; b ^= c; b = rotl(b, 12)
a += b; d ^= a; d = rotl(d, 8)
c += d; b ^= c; b = rotl(b, 7)

// Fold 16 words to 2:
h0 = state[0] ^ state[2] ^ state[4] ^ state[6] ^ state[8] ^ state[10] ^ state[12] ^ state[14]
h1 = state[1] ^ state[3] ^ state[5] ^ state[7] ^ state[9] ^ state[11] ^ state[13] ^ state[15]
return (h0, h1) // h0 is low 32 bits
```

**Trailing zero count:** Count trailing zero bits of the 64-bit value [h0 | (h1 << 32)].
That is, count from h0's LSB first; if h0 == 0, add 32 and continue counting from h1.

**Algorithm:**
1. Each thread computes: my_nonce = params.y + gid.x (range_start + thread ID)
2. Guard: if gid.x >= params.z, return (out of range)
3. Compute hash, count trailing zeros
4. If trailing_zeros >= difficulty:
Write result[0]=1u, result[1]=nonce, result[2]=h0, result[3]=h1
(Race writes are acceptable - any valid nonce will be verified on CPU)

**Important WGSL notes:**
- Use `var state : array` for the mutable hash state.
- WGSL rotation: `(x << shift) | (x >> (32u - shift))` — all values must be u32.
- The inner quarter-round loop MUST be unrolled (write out all 4 groups
of state[0..3], state[4..7], state[8..11], state[12..15] explicitly).
- Do NOT use atomics. Plain stores to result[] are sufficient.
- All integer literals must be typed: use `0u`, `1u`, `16u`, `32u` etc.

The shader will be dispatched with ceil(range_size / 256) workgroups.
Only ONE dispatch is performed - find the nonce in a single pass.


**Test Configurations:**

Subpass 1: difficulty=8 bits, search_range=1,048,576
Subpass 2: difficulty=12 bits, search_range=16,777,216
Subpass 3: difficulty=16 bits, search_range=268,435,456
Subpass 4: difficulty=20 bits, search_range=1,073,741,824

The shader must implement the exact hash function described above.

Test 48: 2D Fluid Simulation - Lattice Boltzmann (SPIR-V ASM Compute) Score: 0.00 / 5
Typical Prompt:
Write a SPIR-V assembly compute shader for 2D Lattice Boltzmann fluid simulation.

**SPIR-V Assembly Compute Shader Interface:**

The shader uses the D2Q9 Lattice Boltzmann model for 2D fluid simulation.

**D2Q9 velocity directions (index k -> (cx, cy)):**
```
k=0: ( 0, 0) w=4/9 (rest)
k=1: ( 1, 0) w=1/9 (east)
k=2: ( 0, 1) w=1/9 (north)
k=3: (-1, 0) w=1/9 (west)
k=4: ( 0,-1) w=1/9 (south)
k=5: ( 1, 1) w=1/36 (NE)
k=6: (-1, 1) w=1/36 (NW)
k=7: (-1,-1) w=1/36 (SW)
k=8: ( 1,-1) w=1/36 (SE)
```

**Buffer layout:**
- Binding 0 (storage, read-only): float array, length W*H*9
Index = (y * W + x) * 9 + k
- Binding 1 (storage, read-write): float array, length W*H*9 (output, NOT writeonly)
- Binding 2 (uniform): { uvec4(W, H, 0, 0), vec4(omega, 0, 0, 0) }

**Algorithm (per cell at gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy):**
Compute one LBM step (collision + streaming) for each lattice cell. Guard against
out-of-bounds (x >= W or y >= H). For the cell distributions f[0..8], compute
macroscopic density rho and velocity (ux, uy) using the D2Q9 directions. Apply
the BGK collision update with:

cu = cx[k]*ux + cy[k]*uy
feq = w[k] * rho * (1 + 3*cu + 4.5*cu*cu - 1.5*(ux*ux + uy*uy))
f_out = f[k] + omega * (feq - f[k])

Then stream each f_out to the neighbor cell (x+cx[k], y+cy[k]) with periodic
wraparound in both axes. Write to the output buffer at the corresponding
neighbor index for k.

**SPIR-V requirements:**
- OpCapability Shader
- OpExecutionMode with LocalSize 16 16 1
- Use gl_GlobalInvocationID for (x, y)
- Declare runtime arrays for storage buffers with OpDecorate ArrayStride 4
- Use OpSMod or manual modulo for periodic boundary conditions


**Test Configurations:**

Subpass 1: 64x64 grid, 100 steps, viscosity=0.1, omega=1.2500

Subpass 3: 128x128 grid, 200 steps, viscosity=0.05, omega=1.5385
Subpass 4: 256x256 grid, 200 steps, viscosity=0.02, omega=1.7857

Test 49: Parallel Prefix Sum (SPIR-V Binary Compute) Score: 5.00 / 5
Typical Prompt:
Write a SPIR-V binary compute shader (hex-encoded) for parallel inclusive prefix sum.

**SPIR-V Binary (hex-encoded) Compute Shader Interface:**

You must produce raw SPIR-V binary encoded as a hex string (no spaces, no 0x prefix).
The binary must start with the SPIR-V magic number 0x07230203.

**Required layout:**
```
Binding 0 (set=0): Storage buffer (read-only) - uint array, length N
Binding 1 (set=0): Storage buffer (read-write) - uint array, length N
Binding 2 (set=0): Uniform buffer - uint4: [N, 0, 0, 0]

Local size: 256 x 1 x 1
```

**Algorithm:** Inclusive prefix sum (scan)
- Input: [a0, a1, a2, a3, ...]
- Output: [a0, a0+a1, a0+a1+a2, a0+a1+a2+a3, ...]

Compute an inclusive scan over the input array. For N <= 256, use a shared-memory
scan within a single workgroup (synchronize as needed). For N > 256, a naive
fallback (each thread sums all previous elements) is acceptable but slow; full
marks require a multi-workgroup scan.

**SPIR-V binary encoding notes:**
- Little-endian uint32 words
- Magic: 0x07230203
- Version: 0x00010000 (1.0)
- Bound: upper bound on all IDs used + 1
- Schema: 0
- OpCapability Shader = [0x00020011, 0x00000001]
- OpMemoryModel Logical GLSL450 = [0x00030006, 0x00000001, 0x00000001]
- OpEntryPoint GLCompute = opcode 0x0000000F, execution model 5
- OpExecutionMode LocalSize = opcode 0x00000010, mode 17 (LocalSize)
- OpDecorate Binding = decoration 33
- OpDecorate DescriptorSet = decoration 34
- OpDecorate ArrayStride = decoration 6
- OpDecorate BufferBlock or Block = decoration 2 or 3
- OpTypeInt 32 0 = unsigned int
- OpTypePointer StorageBuffer = storage class 12
- OpVariable StorageBuffer = storage class 12

Encode every uint32 word as exactly 8 hex characters (little-endian).

Subpass 1: N=1,024 elements
Subpass 2: N=4,096 elements

Typical Prompt:
Write a GLSL compute shader for 3D boid flocking simulation.

**GLSL Compute Shader Interface:**

```glsl
#version 450

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

// Each boid stored as two vec4s: [pos.xyz, 0], [vel.xyz, 0]
// Boid i is at index i*2 and i*2+1
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) readonly buffer InputBoids {
vec4 inData[]; // length = N * 2
};

layout(set = 0, binding = 1) buffer OutputBoids {
vec4 outData[]; // length = N * 2
};

layout(set = 0, binding = 2) uniform Params {
uvec4 counts; // counts.x = N
vec4 radii; // radii.x=dt, radii.y=sepRadius, radii.z=alignRadius, radii.w=cohRadius
vec4 weights; // weights.x=sepWeight, weights.y=alignWeight, weights.z=cohWeight, weights.w=maxSpeed
vec4 bounds; // bounds.x=boundSize, bounds.y=boundForce
};
```

**Task:** Write a compute shader that performs ONE timestep of 3D boid
flocking simulation (Reynolds' rules). Each invocation handles one boid
(gl_GlobalInvocationID.x), reading its position/velocity from inData and
writing updated values to outData. Use separation/align/cohesion with the
provided radii and weights, average neighbor contributions, and apply the
boundary force when a component exceeds boundSize*0.4 (push toward center
using boundForce and boundSize*0.5 scaling). Update velocity by accel*dt,
clamp speed to maxSpeed, then update position by vel*dt.

**Critical Requirements:**
- Guard against gl_GlobalInvocationID.x >= N
- Skip self (i == j) and zero-distance neighbors
- Average the accumulated forces by neighbor count (avoid division by zero)
- Clamp velocity magnitude to maxSpeed


**Flocking Parameters (constant across all subpasses):**
Separation radius: 2.0, weight: 1.5
Alignment radius: 5.0, weight: 1.0
Cohesion radius: 8.0, weight: 1.0
Max speed: 5.0
Bound size: 50.0, bound force: 0.5

**Test Configurations:**
Subpass 0: N=128, timesteps=50, dt=0.05
Subpass 1: N=256, timesteps=100, dt=0.05
Subpass 2: N=512, timesteps=100, dt=0.05
Subpass 3: N=1024, timesteps=200, dt=0.05
Subpass 4: N=2048, timesteps=200, dt=0.05
Subpass 5: N=4096, timesteps=200, dt=0.05

Write the complete GLSL compute shader source code.
The shader performs ONE step. It will be dispatched multiple times with
ping-pong buffers for the required number of timesteps.

brush up on your knowledge of stalls, asymetric thurst, yaw dampening, and trim.

previous values, etc. They persist across calls within a scenario.

Key facts:
- Wheel speed sensors (4): FL, FR, RL, RR in km/h. Any can fail.
- Gyroscopes (3): yaw rate in degrees/second. Any can fail silently.
- Accelerometers (3): longitudinal and lateral in m/s². Any can fail.
- GPS (2): position in meters, speed in km/h. Can lose signal.
- Lidar (12 beams): range in meters at angles from -90° to +90°.

obstacle detection (bool + distance + relative speed), speed limit signs,
lane offset, road curvature. ANY can fail or flicker!

- `target_speed_kmh`: desired speed. `target_lane`: desired lane (0-2).
- `*_valid` flags exist but may be WRONG on failed sensors.
- Sensors can FLICKER: randomly return invalid data for a few frames.

```
steering: -1.0 (full left) to +1.0 (full right)
0.0 = straight ahead
throttle: 0.0 (no power) to 1.0 (full power)
brake: 0.0 (no brake) to 1.0 (emergency stop)
```
If you omit a key, the current value is maintained.

**Critical Design Requirements:**

Typical Prompt:
Write a Python autopilot to dock a spacecraft with a space station in orbit.

**CRITICAL ORBITAL MECHANICS INSIGHT:**
In orbit, relative motion is COUNTER-INTUITIVE:
- Thrusting TOWARD the target (prograde if behind) raises your orbit → you SLOW DOWN relative to target
- To catch up: thrust RETROGRADE (backward!) to lower orbit → you go FASTER
- Radial thrusts cause oscillation, not direct movement
- Cross-track corrections require thrusts at specific orbital positions
- Near the target (<50m), approximate as linear (CW equations work)
- Far away (>200m), full orbital mechanics dominate

**Function Signature:**
```python
def autopilot_step(state: dict, dt: float) -> dict:
```

Key sensor notes:
- Relative position/velocity in LVLH frame: x=radial (up), y=along-track (velocity dir), z=cross-track
- NEGATIVE y = behind station (most common start). Must CLOSE the y gap.
- Range finders give scalar distance. Radar/lidar give 3D relative pos/vel.
- All sensors can fail silently! Cross-check redundant sensors.
- Docking camera only active within 500m. Gives bearing to docking port.
- Ground station data updates every ~30s (stale but reliable).

**Output:** Return a dict:
```
thrust_x: -1.0 to +1.0 (radial: + = away from Earth)
thrust_y: -1.0 to +1.0 (along-track: + = prograde)
thrust_z: -1.0 to +1.0 (cross-track: + = north)
att_rate_roll: rad/s (max ±0.035)
att_rate_pitch: rad/s (max ±0.035)
att_rate_yaw: rad/s (max ±0.035)
```
Each thrust axis: 220N per thruster, Isp=290s. Fuel is LIMITED (~500 kg).

**Docking Success Criteria:**
- Range < 2m AND relative speed < 0.3 m/s

**Approach Strategy Hints:**
1. Far (>200m): Use Hohmann-like transfer — retrograde to lower orbit if behind
2. Medium (50-200m): Gentle corrections, V-bar approach preferred
3. Close (<50m): Linear regime, direct thrust corrections OK
4. Final (<10m): Very gentle, < 0.1 m/s approach speed

**ILS Approach Key Concepts:**
- `glideslope_N_dots`: deviation from 3° glideslope (+above/-below), 3 receivers
- `localizer_N_dots`: deviation from runway centerline (+right/-left), 3 receivers
- `radio_alt_ft`: height above ground (critical for flare)
- `dme_N_nm`: distance to runway threshold
- `weight_on_wheels`: True when landed
- `target_vref_kt`: reference approach speed (typically 137kt)
- `decision_height_ft`: minimum altitude to continue approach (200ft CAT I)
- Elevator command 0 = trimmed flight. Positive = pitch up.

**Output:** Return a dict with any of:
```
elevator: -1.0 (nose down) to +1.0 (nose up), relative to trim
aileron: -1.0 (roll left) to +1.0 (roll right)
rudder: -1.0 (yaw left) to +1.0 (yaw right)
throttle_1: 0.0 to 1.0 (left engine)
throttle_2: 0.0 to 1.0 (right engine)
elevator_trim: -1.0 to +1.0
flaps: degrees (0-40)
gear: 0.0 (up) or 1.0 (down)
speedbrake: 0.0 (retracted) to 1.0 (full)
spoiler: 0.0 or 1.0 (ground spoilers, deploy after touchdown)
autobrake: 0.0 to 1.0 (braking force after touchdown)
reverse_1: 0.0 to 1.0 (left engine reverse thrust)
reverse_2: 0.0 to 1.0 (right engine reverse thrust)
```

**Approach Phases:**
1. **Intercept** (>1000ft): Track glideslope and localizer, configure for landing
2. **Approach** (1000ft-200ft): Stabilise on glideslope, speed, config
3. **Flare** (<50ft radio alt): Reduce descent rate, idle thrust
4. **Touchdown & Rollout**: Deploy spoilers, reverse thrust, autobrake

**Go-Around:**
If the approach is unstable or unsafe, abort the landing:
- Apply TOGA thrust (throttle 1.0), pitch up, retract speedbrake
- Climb to 1500ft AGL — this completes the go-around

- **0.1** — Minor overrun: aircraft rolls off the end but is caught by the

- **0.0** — Catastrophic: touchdown >600 fpm, major overrun

Write a C++ chess bot that for any given chess position, returns the best move to make (or the best
move you can find before the timeout).

You receive the chess position as a string in FEN notation, and you must return the move in
disambiguated algebraic notation (including the starting square, piece type, and destination square).

See:
- https://www.chess.com/terms/fen-chess

Here is an example FEN representing the starting position with white to move:
```
rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1
```

Here is an example disambiguated algebraic move:
```
pe2e4
```
This represents the king's pawn opening - moving the pawn from e2 to e4.

**Move notation rules:**
- Piece letter (lowercase p for pawn, uppercase N/B/R/Q/K for others) + source square + destination square.
- Use "x" between source and destination for captures: `pe4xd5`
- Promotion: append `/` and the piece letter, e.g. `pe7e8/Q`
- Castling: `O-O` (kingside) or `O-O-O` (queenside).
- En passant: append `ep`, e.g. `pe5xd6ep`
- Check: append `+`, e.g. `Bb4c5+`
- Checkmate: append `#`, e.g. `Qd1h5#`

**Input format (stdin, two lines):**
```
timeout_in_seconds
fen_string
```

**Output format (stdout, one line):**
```
move_in_disambiguated_algebraic
```

timeout_in_seconds will be at least 5. Your code will be compiled with full optimisations and
run on a machine with multiple cores, so threading is encouraged.

Early subpasses test trivial tactics (hanging pieces, mate in one). Middle subpasses present classic chess puzzles requiring short tactical sequences. Later subpasses pit the engine against Stockfish at rising ELO levels, from absolute beginner (100) to grandmaster strength (2500).

#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <map>
#include <chrono>

using namespace std;

// --- Constants and Enums ---

enum Piece {
    EMPTY = 0,
    wP = 1, wN = 2, wB = 3, wR = 4, wQ = 5, wK = 6,
    bP = 7, bN = 8, bB = 9, bR = 10, bQ = 11, bK = 12
};

enum Color { WHITE = 0, BLACK = 1 };

// Piece values for evaluation
const int piece_values[] = {
    0, 
    100, 320, 330, 500, 900, 20000, // White
    100, 320, 330, 500, 900, 20000  // Black
};

// Direction offsets for move generation on a 64-square board
const int knight_offsets[] = { -17, -15, -10, -6, 6, 10, 15, 17 };
const int bishop_offsets[] = { -9, -7, 7, 9 };
const int rook_offsets[] = { -8, -1, 1, 8 };
const int king_offsets[] = { -9, -8, -7, -1, 1, 7, 8, 9 };

// --- Move Structure ---

struct Move {
    int from;
    int to;
    int promotion; // 0 if none, otherwise Piece enum
    
    Move() : from(0), to(0), promotion(0) {}
    Move(int f, int t, int p = 0) : from(f), to(t), promotion(p) {}
    
    // UCI format: e2e4, e7e8q
    string to_uci() const {
        string s = "";
        s += (char)('a' + (from % 8));
        s += (char)('1' + (7 - (from / 8)));
        s += (char)('a' + (to % 8));
        s += (char)('1' + (7 - (to / 8)));
        if (promotion == wQ || promotion == bQ) s += 'q';
        else if (promotion == wR || promotion == bR) s += 'r';
        else if (promotion == wB || promotion == bB) s += 'b';
        else if (promotion == wN || promotion == bN) s += 'n';
        return s;
    }
};

// --- Board Representation ---

struct Board {
    int squares[64];
    Color side_to_move;
    
    // Simplification for this bot: skipping castling rights and en passant 
    // to keep the generator concise and focus on the Minimax engine structure.

    Board() {
        reset();
    }
    
    void reset() {
        // Standard starting position
        int start[64] = {
            bR, bN, bB, bQ, bK, bB, bN, bR,
            bP, bP, bP, bP, bP, bP, bP, bP,
            EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY,
            EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY,
            EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY,
            EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY, EMPTY,
            wP, wP, wP, wP, wP, wP, wP, wP,
            wR, wN, wB, wQ, wK, wB, wN, wR
        };
        for (int i = 0; i < 64; ++i) squares[i] = start[i];
        side_to_move = WHITE;
    }
    
    void make_move(const Move& move) {
        squares[move.to] = squares[move.from];
        squares[move.from] = EMPTY;
        if (move.promotion != 0) {
            squares[move.to] = move.promotion;
        }
        side_to_move = (side_to_move == WHITE) ? BLACK : WHITE;
    }
    
    bool is_white(int piece) const { return piece >= wP && piece <= wK; }
    bool is_black(int piece) const { return piece >= bP && piece <= bK; }
    
    bool is_valid_square(int sq) const { return sq >= 0 && sq < 64; }
    
    // Check if moving off the edge of the board
    bool distance_valid(int from, int to) const {
        int fx = from % 8;
        int fy = from / 8;
        int tx = to % 8;
        int ty = to / 8;
        return abs(fx - tx) <= 2 && abs(fy - ty) <= 2; // Enough for King/Knight checks
    }
};

// --- Move Generation ---

// Generates pseudo-legal moves (doesn't check for king safety for brevity)
vector<Move> generate_moves(const Board& board) {
    vector<Move> moves;
    
    for (int sq = 0; sq < 64; ++sq) {
        int piece = board.squares[sq];
        if (piece == EMPTY) continue;
        
        bool is_white_piece = board.is_white(piece);
        if ((board.side_to_move == WHITE && !is_white_piece) || 
            (board.side_to_move == BLACK && is_white_piece)) {
            continue;
        }
        
        int x = sq % 8;
        int y = sq / 8;
        
        // Pawns
        if (piece == wP) {
            if (sq - 8 >= 0 && board.squares[sq - 8] == EMPTY) {
                if (sq - 8 < 8) moves.push_back(Move(sq, sq - 8, wQ)); // Promotion
                else moves.push_back(Move(sq, sq - 8));
                
                if (y == 6 && board.squares[sq - 16] == EMPTY) { // Double move
                    moves.push_back(Move(sq, sq - 16));
                }
            }
            if (x > 0 && sq - 9 >= 0 && board.is_black(board.squares[sq - 9])) {
                if (sq - 9 < 8) moves.push_back(Move(sq, sq - 9, wQ));
                else moves.push_back(Move(sq, sq - 9));
            }
            if (x < 7 && sq - 7 >= 0 && board.is_black(board.squares[sq - 7])) {
                if (sq - 7 < 8) moves.push_back(Move(sq, sq - 7, wQ));
                else moves.push_back(Move(sq, sq - 7));
            }
        }
        else if (piece == bP) {
            if (sq + 8 < 64 && board.squares[sq + 8] == EMPTY) {
                if (sq + 8 >= 56) moves.push_back(Move(sq, sq + 8, bQ)); // Promotion
                else moves.push_back(Move(sq, sq + 8));
                
                if (y == 1 && board.squares[sq + 16] == EMPTY) { // Double move
                    moves.push_back(Move(sq, sq + 16));
                }
            }
            if (x > 0 && sq + 7 < 64 && board.is_white(board.squares[sq + 7])) {
                if (sq + 7 >= 56) moves.push_back(Move(sq, sq + 7, bQ));
                else moves.push_back(Move(sq, sq + 7));
            }
            if (x < 7 && sq + 9 < 64 && board.is_white(board.squares[sq + 9])) {
                if (sq + 9 >= 56) moves.push_back(Move(sq, sq + 9, bQ));
                else moves.push_back(Move(sq, sq + 9));
            }
        }
        
        // Knights
        else if (piece == wN || piece == bN) {
            for (int offset : knight_offsets) {
                int target = sq + offset;
                if (board.is_valid_square(target) && board.distance_valid(sq, target)) {
                    int target_piece = board.squares[target];
                    if (target_piece == EMPTY || 
                       (is_white_piece ? board.is_black(target_piece) : board.is_white(target_piece))) {
                        moves.push_back(Move(sq, target));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Bishops and Queens (Diagonal)
        if (piece == wB || piece == bB || piece == wQ || piece == bQ) {
            for (int offset : bishop_offsets) {
                for (int target = sq + offset; board.is_valid_square(target); target += offset) {
                    if (abs((target % 8) - ((target - offset) % 8)) > 1) break; // Wrapped around
                    
                    int target_piece = board.squares[target];
                    if (target_piece == EMPTY) {
                        moves.push_back(Move(sq, target));
                    } else {
                        if (is_white_piece ? board.is_black(target_piece) : board.is_white(target_piece)) {
                            moves.push_back(Move(sq, target));
                        }
                        break; // Blocked
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Rooks and Queens (Orthogonal)
        if (piece == wR || piece == bR || piece == wQ || piece == bQ) {
            for (int offset : rook_offsets) {
                for (int target = sq + offset; board.is_valid_square(target); target += offset) {
                    if (offset == -1 || offset == 1) {
                        if (target / 8 != sq / 8) break; // Row change
                    }
                    
                    int target_piece = board.squares[target];
                    if (target_piece == EMPTY) {
                        moves.push_back(Move(sq, target));
                    } else {
                        if (is_white_piece ? board.is_black(target_piece) : board.is_white(target_piece)) {
                            moves.push_back(Move(sq, target));
                        }
                        break; // Blocked
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Kings
        else if (piece == wK || piece == bK) {
            for (int offset : king_offsets) {
                int target = sq + offset;
                if (board.is_valid_square(target) && board.distance_valid(sq, target)) {
                    int target_piece = board.squares[target];
                    if (target_piece == EMPTY || 
                       (is_white_piece ? board.is_black(target_piece) : board.is_white(target_piece))) {
                        moves.push_back(Move(sq, target));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    return moves;
}

// --- Evaluation ---

// Basic material evaluation
int evaluate(const Board& board) {
    int score = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; ++i) {
        int piece = board.squares[i];
        if (piece != EMPTY) {
            if (board.is_white(piece)) {
                score += piece_values[piece];
            } else {
                score -= piece_values[piece];
            }
        }
    }
    // Perspective of the side to move
    return (board.side_to_move == WHITE) ? score : -score;
}

// --- Search Algorithm (Minimax with Alpha-Beta Pruning) ---

const int INF = 1000000;
Move best_move_found;

int alpha_beta(Board& board, int depth, int alpha, int beta) {
    if (depth == 0) {
        return evaluate(board);
    }
    
    vector<Move> moves = generate_moves(board);
    if (moves.empty()) {
        // No moves: Checkmate or stalemate
        // We assume checkmate for simplicity in this skeleton
        return -INF + (100 - depth); // Prefer faster checkmates
    }
    
    for (const Move& move : moves) {
        Board next_board = board;
        next_board.make_move(move);
        
        int score = -alpha_beta(next_board, depth - 1, -beta, -alpha);
        
        if (score >= beta) {
            return beta; // Beta cutoff
        }
        if (score > alpha) {
            alpha = score;
            if (depth == 4) { // Save at root (assume depth 4 search)
                best_move_found = move;
            }
        }
    }
    
    return alpha;
}

Move get_best_move(Board& board, int depth = 4) {
    // Basic root search wrapper
    vector<Move> moves = generate_moves(board);
    if (moves.empty()) return Move(); // Null move
    
    best_move_found = moves[0]; // Fallback
    
    int alpha = -INF;
    int beta = INF;
    
    for (const Move& move : moves) {
        Board next_board = board;
        next_board.make_move(move);
        int score = -alpha_beta(next_board, depth - 1, -beta, -alpha);
        
        if (score > alpha) {
            alpha = score;
            best_move_found = move;
        }
    }
    
    return best_move_found;
}

// --- UCI Protocol Loop ---

void uci_loop() {
    Board board;
    string line;
    
    while (getline(cin, line)) {
        stringstream ss(line);
        string command;
        ss >> command;
        
        if (command == "uci") {
            cout << "id name SimpleCppBot" << endl;
            cout << "id author AI" << endl;
            cout << "uciok" << endl;
        } 
        else if (command == "isready") {
            cout << "readyok" << endl;
        } 
        else if (command == "ucinewgame") {
            board.reset();
        } 
        else if (command == "position") {
            string token;
            ss >> token;
            if (token == "startpos") {
                board.reset();
                if (ss >> token && token == "moves") {
                    string move_str;
                    while (ss >> move_str) {
                        // Very naive move parser for "e2e4" format
                        if (move_str.length() >= 4) {
                            int from = (move_str[0] - 'a') + (7 - (move_str[1] - '1')) * 8;
                            int to = (move_str[2] - 'a') + (7 - (move_str[3] - '1')) * 8;
                            board.make_move(Move(from, to)); // Doesn't handle promotion parsing correctly for brevity
                        }
                    }
                }
            } 
            // FEN parsing would go here, omitted for brevity
        } 
        else if (command == "go") {
            // Find best move with depth 4
            Move best = get_best_move(board, 4);
            cout << "bestmove " << best.to_uci() << endl;
        } 
        else if (command == "quit") {
            break;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    // Run the UCI loop allowing GUI interaction (like Arena, Cutechess)
    uci_loop();
    return 0;
}

Wildfire Firebreak Planner - 32x22 forest, 3 towns

View JavaScript code (12565 chars)
const fs = require('fs');

function solve() {
    let input;
    try {
        input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
    } catch (e) {
        return;
    }
    if (!input) return;
    const data = JSON.parse(input);

    const width = data.width;
    const height = data.height;
    const grid = data.grid;
    const ignitions = data.ignitions;
    const towns = data.towns;
    const cutBudget = data.cutBudget;

    if (cutBudget <= 0) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks: [] }));
        return;
    }

    const ignitionSet = new Set();
    for (const [x, y] of ignitions) {
        if (x >= 0 && x < width && y >= 0 && y < height) {
            ignitionSet.add(y * width + x);
        }
    }

    // Run BFS to find all reachable cells from ignitions
    const reachable = new Uint8Array(width * height);
    const queue = new Int32Array(width * height);
    let headQ = 0, tailQ = 0;

    for (const cellIdx of ignitionSet) {
        if (grid[Math.floor(cellIdx / width)][cellIdx % width] === '.') {
            reachable[cellIdx] = 1;
            queue[tailQ++] = cellIdx;
        }
    }

    const dx = [1, -1, 0, 0];
    const dy = [0, 0, 1, -1];

    while (headQ < tailQ) {
        const curr = queue[headQ++];
        const cx = curr % width;
        const cy = Math.floor(curr / width);
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const nx = cx + dx[i];
            const ny = cy + dy[i];
            if (nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height) {
                if (grid[ny][nx] === '.') {
                    const nidx = ny * width + nx;
                    if (!reachable[nidx]) {
                        reachable[nidx] = 1;
                        queue[tailQ++] = nidx;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    const R = [];
    const gridToFlow = new Int32Array(width * height);
    gridToFlow.fill(-1);
    for (let i = 0; i < width * height; i++) {
        if (reachable[i]) {
            gridToFlow[i] = R.length;
            R.push(i);
        }
    }

    const M = R.length;
    if (M === 0) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks: [] }));
        return;
    }

    const cellToTown = new Map();
    for (const t of towns) {
        const cellIdx = t.y * width + t.x;
        if (cellIdx >= 0 && cellIdx < width * height && gridToFlow[cellIdx] >= 0) {
            if (cellToTown.has(cellIdx)) {
                const existing = cellToTown.get(cellIdx);
                existing.value += t.value;
            } else {
                cellToTown.set(cellIdx, {
                    cellIdx: cellIdx,
                    flowIdx: gridToFlow[cellIdx],
                    value: t.value
                });
            }
        }
    }

    const activeTowns = Array.from(cellToTown.values());

    if (activeTowns.length === 0) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks: [] }));
        return;
    }

    const INF = 1000000000;
    const numNodes = 2 * M + 2;
    const S_star = 2 * M;
    const T_star = 2 * M + 1;

    const head = new Int32Array(numNodes);
    head.fill(-1);

    const maxEdges = 16 * M + activeTowns.length * 2 + 100;
    const to = new Int32Array(maxEdges);
    const cap = new Int32Array(maxEdges);
    const flow = new Int32Array(maxEdges);
    const next = new Int32Array(maxEdges);
    let edgeCount = 0;

    function addEdge(u, v, c) {
        to[edgeCount] = v;
        cap[edgeCount] = c;
        flow[edgeCount] = 0;
        next[edgeCount] = head[u];
        head[u] = edgeCount++;

        to[edgeCount] = u;
        cap[edgeCount] = 0;
        flow[edgeCount] = 0;
        next[edgeCount] = head[v];
        head[v] = edgeCount++;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        const cellIdx = R[i];
        const isIgnition = ignitionSet.has(cellIdx);
        const isTown = cellToTown.has(cellIdx);
        const capacity = (isIgnition || isTown) ? INF : 1;
        addEdge(2 * i, 2 * i + 1, capacity);
    }

    for (const cellIdx of ignitionSet) {
        const flowIdx = gridToFlow[cellIdx];
        if (flowIdx >= 0) {
            addEdge(S_star, 2 * flowIdx, INF);
        }
    }

    const townEdgeIdx = new Int32Array(activeTowns.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < activeTowns.length; i++) {
        const t = activeTowns[i];
        townEdgeIdx[i] = edgeCount;
        addEdge(2 * t.flowIdx + 1, T_star, 0);
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        const cx = R[i] % width;
        const cy = Math.floor(R[i] / width);
        for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            const nx = cx + dx[k];
            const ny = cy + dy[k];
            if (nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height) {
                const nidx = ny * width + nx;
                const j = gridToFlow[nidx];
                if (j >= 0) {
                    addEdge(2 * i + 1, 2 * j, INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    const level = new Int32Array(numNodes);
    const queueArr = new Int32Array(numNodes);
    const work = new Int32Array(numNodes);
    const pathNodes = new Int32Array(numNodes);
    const pathEdges = new Int32Array(numNodes);

    function bfsDinic(source, sink) {
        level.fill(-1);
        level[source] = 0;
        let headQ = 0, tailQ = 0;
        queueArr[tailQ++] = source;
        while (headQ < tailQ) {
            const u = queueArr[headQ++];
            for (let e = head[u]; e !== -1; e = next[e]) {
                const v = to[e];
                if (cap[e] - flow[e] > 0 && level[v] === -1) {
                    level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                    queueArr[tailQ++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return level[sink] !== -1;
    }

    function runDinic(source, sink, limit) {
        let totalFlow = 0;
        while (totalFlow <= limit) {
            if (!bfsDinic(source, sink)) break;
            work.set(head);
            
            let depth = 0;
            pathNodes[0] = source;
            
            while (true) {
                let u = pathNodes[depth];
                if (u === sink) {
                    let pathFlow = limit - totalFlow + 1;
                    for (let d = 0; d < depth; d++) {
                        const e = pathEdges[d];
                        const tr = cap[e] - flow[e];
                        if (tr < pathFlow) pathFlow = tr;
                    }
                    
                    for (let d = 0; d < depth; d++) {
                        const e = pathEdges[d];
                        flow[e] += pathFlow;
                        flow[e ^ 1] -= pathFlow;
                    }
                    
                    totalFlow += pathFlow;
                    if (totalFlow > limit) break;
                    
                    let newDepth = 0;
                    for (let d = 0; d < depth; d++) {
                        const e = pathEdges[d];
                        if (cap[e] - flow[e] === 0) {
                            newDepth = d;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    depth = newDepth;
                } else {
                    let foundEdge = -1;
                    for (let e = work[u]; e !== -1; e = next[e]) {
                        work[u] = e;
                        const v = to[e];
                        if (level[v] === level[u] + 1 && cap[e] - flow[e] > 0) {
                            foundEdge = e;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (foundEdge !== -1) {
                        pathEdges[depth] = foundEdge;
                        pathNodes[depth + 1] = to[foundEdge];
                        depth++;
                    } else {
                        level[u] = -1;
                        if (depth === 0) break;
                        depth--;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    function getReachableNodes(source) {
        const visited = new Uint8Array(numNodes);
        const q = new Int32Array(numNodes);
        let headQ = 0, tailQ = 0;
        visited[source] = 1;
        q[tailQ++] = source;
        while (headQ < tailQ) {
            const u = q[headQ++];
            for (let e = head[u]; e !== -1; e = next[e]) {
                const v = to[e];
                if (cap[e] - flow[e] > 0 && !visited[v]) {
                    visited[v] = 1;
                    q[tailQ++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return visited;
    }

    const useMultiPass = (M * activeTowns.length <= 150000);
    const committedTowns = new Set();
    const savedFlow = new Int32Array(flow.length);
    let currentFlow = 0;

    if (useMultiPass) {
        while (true) {
            let bestTownIdx = -1;
            let bestEff = -1;
            let bestDeltaCost = Infinity;
            let bestVal = -1;

            savedFlow.set(flow);

            for (let i = 0; i < activeTowns.length; i++) {
                if (committedTowns.has(i)) continue;

                cap[townEdgeIdx[i]] = INF;
                let limit = cutBudget - currentFlow;
                let inc = runDinic(S_star, T_star, limit);

                if (inc <= limit) {
                    let deltaCost = inc;
                    let val = activeTowns[i].value;
                    if (deltaCost === 0) {
                        if (bestDeltaCost > 0 || val > bestVal) {
                            bestTownIdx = i;
                            bestEff = Infinity;
                            bestDeltaCost = 0;
                            bestVal = val;
                        }
                    } else {
                        let eff = val / deltaCost;
                        if (bestDeltaCost > 0 && (eff > bestEff || (eff === bestEff && val > bestVal))) {
                            bestTownIdx = i;
                            bestEff = eff;
                            bestDeltaCost = deltaCost;
                            bestVal = val;
                        }
                    }
                }

                flow.set(savedFlow);
                cap[townEdgeIdx[i]] = 0;
            }

            if (bestTownIdx === -1) {
                break;
            }

            committedTowns.add(bestTownIdx);
            cap[townEdgeIdx[bestTownIdx]] = INF;
            let inc = runDinic(S_star, T_star, cutBudget - currentFlow);
            currentFlow += inc;
        }
    } else {
        const townCosts = new Int32Array(activeTowns.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < activeTowns.length; i++) {
            savedFlow.set(flow);
            cap[townEdgeIdx[i]] = INF;
            let cost = runDinic(S_star, T_star, cutBudget);
            townCosts[i] = cost;
            flow.set(savedFlow);
            cap[townEdgeIdx[i]] = 0;
        }

        const indices = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < activeTowns.length; i++) {
            if (townCosts[i] <= cutBudget) {
                indices.push(i);
            }
        }

        indices.sort((a, b) => {
            const costA = townCosts[a];
            const costB = townCosts[b];
            const valA = activeTowns[a].value;
            const valB = activeTowns[b].value;
            
            const ratioA = costA === 0 ? Infinity : valA / costA;
            const ratioB = costB === 0 ? Infinity : valB / costB;
            if (ratioA !== ratioB) return ratioB - ratioA;
            return valB - valA;
        });

        for (const i of indices) {
            savedFlow.set(flow);
            cap[townEdgeIdx[i]] = INF;
            let limit = cutBudget - currentFlow;
            let inc = runDinic(S_star, T_star, limit);
            if (inc <= limit) {
                committedTowns.add(i);
                currentFlow += inc;
            } else {
                flow.set(savedFlow);
                cap[townEdgeIdx[i]] = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    const reachableNodes = getReachableNodes(S_star);
    const firebreaks = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        const cellIdx = R[i];
        const isIgnition = ignitionSet.has(cellIdx);
        const isTown = cellToTown.has(cellIdx);
        if (!isIgnition && !isTown) {
            const inNode = 2 * i;
            const outNode = 2 * i + 1;
            if (reachableNodes[inNode] && !reachableNodes[outNode]) {
                const x = cellIdx % width;
                const y = Math.floor(cellIdx / width);
                firebreaks.push([x, y]);
            }
        }
    }

    console.log(JSON.stringify({ firebreaks }));
}

solve();

const fs = require('fs');

function solve() {
    const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
    if (!input.trim()) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify({ assignments: [] }));
        return;
    }
    const data = JSON.parse(input);
    const grid = data.grid;
    const robots = data.robots;
    const jobs = data.jobs;

    if (!grid || grid.length === 0 || !robots || robots.length === 0 || !jobs || jobs.length === 0) {
        console.log(JSON.stringify({ assignments: [] }));
        return;
    }

    const H = grid.length;
    const W = grid[0].length;

    const blocked = new Uint8Array(W * H);
    for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {
        const row = grid[y];
        for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
            if (row[x] === '#') {
                blocked[y * W + x] = 1;
            }
        }
    }

    robots.forEach((r, idx) => {
        r.nodeIdx = idx;
    });
    jobs.forEach((j, idx) => {
        j.nodeIdx = robots.length + idx;
    });

    const nodes = [];
    for (const r of robots) {
        nodes.push(r);
    }
    for (const j of jobs) {
        nodes.push(j);
    }

    const N = nodes.length;
    const maxRobotId = Math.max(...robots.map(r => r.id));

    let tourId = 0;
    const visited = new Int32Array(W * H);
    const dist = new Int32Array(W * H);
    const queue = new Int32Array(W * H);
    const cachedDists = new Array(N).fill(null);

    function getDistancesFromNode(nodeIdx) {
        if (cachedDists[nodeIdx] !== null) {
            return cachedDists[nodeIdx];
        }

        const node = nodes[nodeIdx];
        tourId++;
        let head = 0;
        let tail = 0;

        const startIdx = node.y * W + node.x;
        visited[startIdx] = tourId;
        dist[startIdx] = 0;
        queue[tail++] = startIdx;

        const dx = [0, 0, 1, -1];
        const dy = [1, -1, 0, 0];

        while (head < tail) {
            const u = queue[head++];
            const ux = u % W;
            const uy = Math.floor(u / W);
            const d = dist[u];

            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                const vx = ux + dx[i];
                const vy = uy + dy[i];
                if (vx >= 0 && vx < W && vy >= 0 && vy < H) {
                    const v = vy * W + vx;
                    if (!blocked[v] && visited[v] !== tourId) {
                        visited[v] = tourId;
                        dist[v] = d + 1;
                        queue[tail++] = v;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        const dists = new Int32Array(N);
        for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            const targetIdx = nodes[i].y * W + nodes[i].x;
            if (visited[targetIdx] === tourId) {
                dists[i] = dist[targetIdx];
            } else {
                dists[i] = -1;
            }
        }

        cachedDists[nodeIdx] = dists;
        return dists;
    }

    function getDistance(uIdx, vIdx) {
        const dists = getDistancesFromNode(uIdx);
        return dists[vIdx];
    }

    function solvePFG() {
        const assignments = Array.from({ length: maxRobotId + 1 }, () => []);
        const sortedJobs = [...jobs].sort((a, b) => {
            if (b.priority !== a.priority) {
                return b.priority - a.priority;
            }
            return a.id - b.id;
        });

        const robotCurrentNode = robots.map(r => r.nodeIdx);

        for (const job of sortedJobs) {
            let minD = Infinity;
            let bestRIdx = -1;

            for (let r = 0; r < robots.length; r++) {
                const currNode = robotCurrentNode[r];
                const d = getDistance(currNode, job.nodeIdx);
                if (d !== -1 && d < minD) {
                    minD = d;
                    bestRIdx = r;
                }
            }

            if (bestRIdx === -1) {
                bestRIdx = 0;
            }

            const robot = robots[bestRIdx];
            assignments[robot.id].push(job.id);
            robotCurrentNode[bestRIdx] = job.nodeIdx;
        }

        return assignments;
    }

    function solveCFG() {
        const assignments = Array.from({ length: maxRobotId + 1 }, () => []);
        const assigned = new Uint8Array(jobs.length);

        const robotCurrentNode = robots.map(r => r.nodeIdx);
        const closestJobIdx = new Int32Array(robots.length).fill(-1);
        const closestDist = new Int32Array(robots.length).fill(-1);

        function updateClosest(r) {
            let minDist = Infinity;
            let bestJobIdx = -1;
            const currNode = robotCurrentNode[r];
            const dists = getDistancesFromNode(currNode);

            for (let j = 0; j < jobs.length; j++) {
                if (!assigned[j]) {
                    const jobNodeIdx = jobs[j].nodeIdx;
                    const d = dists[jobNodeIdx];
                    if (d !== -1 && d < minDist) {
                        minDist = d;
                        bestJobIdx = j;
                    }
                }
            }
            closestJobIdx[r] = bestJobIdx;
            closestDist[r] = bestJobIdx === -1 ? Infinity : minDist;
        }

        for (let r = 0; r < robots.length; r++) {
            updateClosest(r);
        }

        for (let step = 0; step < jobs.length; step++) {
            let minDist = Infinity;
            let bestRIdx = -1;

            for (let r = 0; r < robots.length; r++) {
                if (closestDist[r] < minDist) {
                    minDist = closestDist[r];
                    bestRIdx = r;
                }
            }

            if (bestRIdx === -1 || minDist === Infinity) {
                const fallbackRobot = robots[0];
                for (let j = 0; j < jobs.length; j++) {
                    if (!assigned[j]) {
                        assignments[fallbackRobot.id].push(jobs[j].id);
                        assigned[j] = 1;
                    }
                }
                break;
            }

            const bestJIdx = closestJobIdx[bestRIdx];
            const job = jobs[bestJIdx];
            const robot = robots[bestRIdx];

            assignments[robot.id].push(job.id);
            assigned[bestJIdx] = 1;
            robotCurrentNode[bestRIdx] = job.nodeIdx;

            updateClosest(bestRIdx);
            for (let r = 0; r < robots.length; r++) {
                if (r !== bestRIdx && closestJobIdx[r] === bestJIdx) {
                    updateClosest(r);
                }
            }
        }

        return assignments;
    }

    function solvePGCFG() {
        const assignments = Array.from({ length: maxRobotId + 1 }, () => []);

        const groups = new Map();
        for (const job of jobs) {
            if (!groups.has(job.priority)) {
                groups.set(job.priority, []);
            }
            groups.get(job.priority).push(job);
        }

        const sortedPriorities = Array.from(groups.keys()).sort((a, b) => b - a);
        const robotCurrentNode = robots.map(r => r.nodeIdx);

        for (const priority of sortedPriorities) {
            const groupJobs = groups.get(priority);
            const groupAssigned = new Uint8Array(groupJobs.length);

            const closestJobIdxInGroup = new Int32Array(robots.length).fill(-1);
            const closestDist = new Int32Array(robots.length).fill(-1);

            const updateClosestForGroup = (r) => {
                let minDist = Infinity;
                let bestJobIdx = -1;
                const currNode = robotCurrentNode[r];
                const dists = getDistancesFromNode(currNode);

                for (let j = 0; j < groupJobs.length; j++) {
                    if (!groupAssigned[j]) {
                        const jobNodeIdx = groupJobs[j].nodeIdx;
                        const d = dists[jobNodeIdx];
                        if (d !== -1 && d < minDist) {
                            minDist = d;
                            bestJobIdx = j;
                        }
                    }
                }
                closestJobIdxInGroup[r] = bestJobIdx;
                closestDist[r] = bestJobIdx === -1 ? Infinity : minDist;
            };

            for (let r = 0; r < robots.length; r++) {
                updateClosestForGroup(r);
            }

            for (let step = 0; step < groupJobs.length; step++) {
                let minDist = Infinity;
                let bestRIdx = -1;
                for (let r = 0; r < robots.length; r++) {
                    if (closestDist[r] < minDist) {
                        minDist = closestDist[r];
                        bestRIdx = r;
                    }
                }

                if (bestRIdx === -1 || minDist === Infinity) {
                    const fallbackRobot = robots[0];
                    for (let j = 0; j < groupJobs.length; j++) {
                        if (!groupAssigned[j]) {
                            assignments[fallbackRobot.id].push(groupJobs[j].id);
                            groupAssigned[j] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                    break;
                }

                const bestJIdx = closestJobIdxInGroup[bestRIdx];
                const job = groupJobs[bestJIdx];
                const robot = robots[bestRIdx];

                assignments[robot.id].push(job.id);
                groupAssigned[bestJIdx] = 1;
                robotCurrentNode[bestRIdx] = job.nodeIdx;

                updateClosestForGroup(bestRIdx);
                for (let r = 0; r < robots.length; r++) {
                    if (r !== bestRIdx && closestJobIdxInGroup[r] === bestJIdx) {
                        updateClosestForGroup(r);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return assignments;
    }

    function evaluateAssignment(assignments) {
        let totalTravel = 0;
        const jobMap = new Map();
        for (const job of jobs) {
            jobMap.set(job.id, job);
        }

        for (let r = 0; r < robots.length; r++) {
            const robot = robots[r];
            const path = assignments[robot.id] || [];
            if (path.length === 0) continue;

            let currNodeIdx = robot.nodeIdx;
            for (const jobId of path) {
                const job = jobMap.get(jobId);
                const d = getDistance(currNodeIdx, job.nodeIdx);
                if (d !== -1) {
                    totalTravel += d;
                }
                currNodeIdx = job.nodeIdx;
            }
        }
        return totalTravel;
    }

    function optimizeLocalSearch(assignments, startTime, maxTimeMs) {
        let improved = true;
        const jobMap = new Map();
        for (const job of jobs) {
            jobMap.set(job.id, job);
        }

        function getPathDistance(robot, path) {
            if (path.length === 0) return 0;
            let distSum = 0;
            let currNodeIdx = robot.nodeIdx;
            for (const jobId of path) {
                const job = jobMap.get(jobId);
                const d = getDistance(currNodeIdx, job.nodeIdx);
                if (d !== -1) {
                    distSum += d;
                }
                currNodeIdx = job.nodeIdx;
            }
            return distSum;
        }

        while (improved) {
            if (Date.now() - startTime > maxTimeMs) {
                break;
            }
            improved = false;

            // 1. Intra-route optimization (swap consecutive)
            for (let r = 0; r < robots.length; r++) {
                const robot = robots[r];
                const path = assignments[robot.id];
                if (!path || path.length < 2) continue;

                for (let i = 0; i < path.length - 1; i++) {
                    const oldDist = getPathDistance(robot, path);

                    const temp = path[i];
                    path[i] = path[i + 1];
                    path[i + 1] = temp;

                    const newDist = getPathDistance(robot, path);

                    if (newDist < oldDist) {
                        improved = true;
                    } else {
                        const temp2 = path[i];
                        path[i] = path[i + 1];
                        path[i + 1] = temp2;
                    }
                }
            }

            // 2. Inter-route optimization (move a job to another robot)
            for (let r1 = 0; r1 < robots.length; r1++) {
                const robot1 = robots[r1];
                const path1 = assignments[robot1.id];
                if (!path1 || path1.length === 0) continue;

                for (let r2 = 0; r2 < robots.length; r2++) {
                    if (r1 === r2) continue;
                    const robot2 = robots[r2];
                    const path2 = assignments[robot2.id] || [];

                    for (let i = 0; i < path1.length; i++) {
                        const jobId = path1[i];

                        for (let j = 0; j <= path2.length; j++) {
                            const oldDist1 = getPathDistance(robot1, path1);
                            const oldDist2 = getPathDistance(robot2, path2);

                            const newPath1 = path1.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i);
                            const newPath2 = [...path2];
                            newPath2.splice(j, 0, jobId);

                            const newDist1 = getPathDistance(robot1, newPath1);
                            const newDist2 = getPathDistance(robot2, newPath2);

                            if (newDist1 + newDist2 < oldDist1 + oldDist2) {
                                assignments[robot1.id] = newPath1;
                                assignments[robot2.id] = newPath2;
                                improved = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (improved) break;
                    }
                    if (improved) break;
                }
                if (improved) break;
            }
        }
    }

    const strategies = [
        { name: 'CFG', solve: solveCFG },
        { name: 'PFG', solve: solvePFG },
        { name: 'PGCFG', solve: solvePGCFG }
    ];

    let bestAssignment = null;
    let minTotalTravel = Infinity;

    for (const strategy of strategies) {
        const assignments = strategy.solve();
        const initialTravel = evaluateAssignment(assignments);
        optimizeLocalSearch(assignments, Date.now(), 600); // 600ms per strategy
        const travel = evaluateAssignment(assignments);
        console.warn(`Strategy: ${strategy.name}, Initial Travel: ${initialTravel}, Optimized Travel: ${travel}, Assignments: ${JSON.stringify(assignments)}`);
        if (travel < minTotalTravel) {
            minTotalTravel = travel;
            bestAssignment = assignments;
        }
    }

    console.log(JSON.stringify({ assignments: bestAssignment }));
}

const fs = require('fs');

function solve() {
    const input = fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
    if (!input || input.trim() === '') {
        return;
    }
    const data = JSON.parse(input);
    const width = data.probability[0].length;
    const height = data.probability.length;
    const drones = data.drones;
    const maxSteps = data.maxStepsPerDrone;
    const probability = data.probability;

    // Helper to get cells in radius R (Manhattan distance)
    function getNeighborsInRadius(x, y, R) {
        const neighbors = [];
        for (let dy = -R; dy <= R; dy++) {
            const limit = R - Math.abs(dy);
            for (let dx = -limit; dx <= limit; dx++) {
                const nx = x + dx;
                const ny = y + dy;
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height) {
                    neighbors.push([nx, ny]);
                }
            }
        }
        return neighbors;
    }

    // BFS to find shortest paths from start to all cells
    function bfs(startX, startY) {
        const dist = Array.from({ length: height }, () => new Int32Array(width).fill(-1));
        const parent = Array.from({ length: height }, () => new Int32Array(width).fill(-1));
        const queueX = new Int32Array(width * height);
        const queueY = new Int32Array(width * height);
        let head = 0, tail = 0;

        queueX[tail] = startX;
        queueY[tail] = startY;
        dist[startY][startX] = 0;
        tail++;

        const dx = [1, -1, 0, 0];
        const dy = [0, 0, 1, -1];

        while (head < tail) {
            const cx = queueX[head];
            const cy = queueY[head];
            head++;

            const d = dist[cy][cx];
            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                const nx = cx + dx[i];
                const ny = cy + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height) {
                    if (probability[ny][nx] >= 0 && dist[ny][nx] === -1) {
                        dist[ny][nx] = d + 1;
                        parent[ny][nx] = cy * width + cx;
                        queueX[tail] = nx;
                        queueY[tail] = ny;
                        tail++;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return { dist, parent };
    }

    // Evaluate coverage score for a planned set of paths
    function getCoverageScore(paths) {
        const covered = Array.from({ length: height }, () => new Uint8Array(width));
        let score = 0;
        for (let d = 0; d < paths.length; d++) {
            const path = paths[d];
            for (let i = 0; i < path.length; i++) {
                const [x, y] = path[i];
                if (!covered[y][x]) {
                    covered[y][x] = 1;
                    const val = probability[y][x];
                    if (val > 0) {
                        score += val;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return score;
    }

    // Run the solver with specific parameters
    function runSimulation(R, beta, K) {
        // Precompute neighbors in radius R
        const neighborsGrid = [];
        for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
            const row = [];
            for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
                row.push(getNeighborsInRadius(x, y, R));
            }
            neighborsGrid.push(row);
        }

        const isCovered = Array.from({ length: height }, () => new Uint8Array(width));
        for (let d = 0; d < drones.length; d++) {
            isCovered[drones[d].y][drones[d].x] = 1;
        }

        // Initialize density map
        const density = Array.from({ length: height }, () => new Float32Array(width));
        for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
            for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
                let sum = 0;
                const nb = neighborsGrid[y][x];
                for (let i = 0; i < nb.length; i++) {
                    const [nx, ny] = nb[i];
                    if (!isCovered[ny][nx] && probability[ny][nx] > 0) {
                        sum += probability[ny][nx];
                    }
                }
                density[y][x] = sum;
            }
        }

        const paths = [];
        for (let d = 0; d < drones.length; d++) {
            const drone = drones[d];
            let cx = drone.x;
            let cy = drone.y;
            const path = [[cx, cy]];

            let targetX = -1;
            let targetY = -1;
            let pathToTarget = [];
            let pathIdx = 0;
            let stepsSinceLastEval = 0;

            for (let step = 0; step < maxSteps; step++) {
                const remSteps = maxSteps - step;

                let needNewTarget = false;
                if (targetX === -1 || targetY === -1) {
                    needNewTarget = true;
                } else if (cx === targetX && cy === targetY) {
                    needNewTarget = true;
                } else if (isCovered[targetY][targetX] || density[targetY][targetX] <= 0) {
                    needNewTarget = true;
                } else if (stepsSinceLastEval >= K) {
                    needNewTarget = true;
                } else if (pathIdx >= pathToTarget.length) {
                    needNewTarget = true;
                }

                if (needNewTarget) {
                    const { dist, parent } = bfs(cx, cy);

                    let bestTX = -1, bestTY = -1;
                    let maxScore = -1;

                    for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
                        for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
                            const dVal = dist[y][x];
                            if (dVal > 0 && dVal <= remSteps) {
                                const dens = density[y][x];
                                if (dens > 0) {
                                    const score = dens / (dVal + beta);
                                    if (score > maxScore) {
                                        maxScore = score;
                                        bestTX = x;
                                        bestTY = y;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (bestTX !== -1) {
                        targetX = bestTX;
                        targetY = bestTY;
                        const tempPath = [];
                        let tx = targetX, ty = targetY;
                        while (tx !== cx || ty !== cy) {
                            tempPath.push([tx, ty]);
                            const p = parent[ty][tx];
                            tx = p % width;
                            ty = Math.floor(p / width);
                        }
                        tempPath.reverse();
                        pathToTarget = tempPath;
                        pathIdx = 0;
                        stepsSinceLastEval = 0;
                    } else {
                        targetX = -1;
                        targetY = -1;
                        pathToTarget = [];
                        pathIdx = 0;
                    }
                }

                let nextX = cx;
                let nextY = cy;

                if (pathIdx < pathToTarget.length) {
                    const nextCell = pathToTarget[pathIdx];
                    nextX = nextCell[0];
                    nextY = nextCell[1];
                    pathIdx++;
                    stepsSinceLastEval++;
                } else {
                    const dx = [1, -1, 0, 0];
                    const dy = [0, 0, 1, -1];
                    let bestNeighborX = cx;
                    let bestNeighborY = cy;
                    let maxP = -1;

                    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                        const nx = cx + dx[i];
                        const ny = cy + dy[i];
                        if (nx >= 0 && nx < width && ny >= 0 && ny < height && probability[ny][nx] >= 0) {
                            const pVal = isCovered[ny][nx] ? 0 : probability[ny][nx];
                            if (pVal > maxP) {
                                maxP = pVal;
                                bestNeighborX = nx;
                                bestNeighborY = ny;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    nextX = bestNeighborX;
                    nextY = bestNeighborY;
                    stepsSinceLastEval = 0;
                }

                cx = nextX;
                cy = nextY;
                path.push([cx, cy]);

                if (!isCovered[cy][cx]) {
                    isCovered[cy][cx] = 1;
                    const val = probability[cy][cx];
                    if (val > 0) {
                        const nb = neighborsGrid[cy][cx];
                        for (let i = 0; i < nb.length; i++) {
                            const [nx, ny] = nb[i];
                            density[ny][nx] -= val;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            paths.push(path);
        }
        return paths;
    }

    const configs = [
        { R: 1, beta: 1, K: 1 },
        { R: 1, beta: 3, K: 3 },
        { R: 2, beta: 1.5, K: 2 },
        { R: 2, beta: 3, K: 3 },
        { R: 3, beta: 2, K: 3 },
        { R: 3, beta: 5, K: 5 },
        { R: 4, beta: 5, K: 5 },
        { R: 5, beta: 10, K: 5 }
    ];

    let bestPaths = null;
    let bestScore = -1;

    for (let c = 0; c < configs.length; c++) {
        const { R, beta, K } = configs[c];
        const paths = runSimulation(R, beta, K);
        const score = getCoverageScore(paths);
        if (score > bestScore) {
            bestScore = score;
            bestPaths = paths;
        }
    }

    console.log(JSON.stringify({ paths: bestPaths }));
}

solve();
